evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-eslat · EsLat

> **English summary** — **EsLat** is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)
> language bundle that translates the **whole web GUI** into neutral **Latin American Spanish**:
> 1,615 labels across all 36 client namespaces shipped by DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 — conversation, sidebar,
> settings, trajectory, tool calls, status summaries, dialogs, errors and empty states. Nothing is
> left falling back to English. Install with `dsh plugin add dsh-eslat`, or from the **Plugins** page
> in the sidebar. Revert to English with Settings → *Idioma* → English. Full documentation below is
> in Spanish.

Traducción completa al **español neutro de Latinoamérica** de la interfaz web de DSH. Es un paquete
de idioma: registra el idioma `es` y un diccionario para **cada** namespace que el cliente de DSH
publica, de modo que la interfaz entera —no solo las herramientas— aparece en español.

```
Conversación      →  Escribe un mensaje o una tarea, / para comandos, @ para archivos o sesiones
Barra lateral     →  Espacios de trabajo · Sesiones · Archivar · Fijar · Cambiar nombre
Ajustes           →  Configuración · Apariencia · Permisos · Tamaño de letra · Atajos
Trayectoria       →  Turnos · Llamadas · Solicitudes · Mediciones · Uso de tokens
Herramientas      →  Leer / Escribir / Editar / Buscar en el contenido / PowerShell / Crear subagente
Estados           →  En ejecución / Preparando la llamada / Fallida / Detenida
Resúmenes         →  Leyendo archivos · Completado en 12 s · Se leyeron archivos y se ejecutaron comandos
```

## Instalación

Es un **bundle** de DSH (`dsh.bundle.patch`), así que se instala como cualquier otro plugin.

### Desde npm

```
dsh plugin add dsh-eslat
```

o en la interfaz web: barra lateral → **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → escribe el nombre del paquete →
**Install**. El diálogo acepta también una dirección Git, un tarball o una ruta local absoluta.

### Desde un tarball

Sin cuenta de npm y sin permisos de compilación: el tarball trae la mitad Cliente ya construida.

```
dsh plugin add ./dsh-eslat-2.0.0.tgz
```

### Desde un repositorio Git

```
dsh plugin add github:Amador-Aguilar/dsh-eslat
```

Este paquete **no necesita `prepare` ni autorizar scripts de compilación**: el bundle del navegador
(`lib/client.js`) se publica construido, no se genera al instalar.

### En este equipo (desarrollo)

En el perfil `desktop` está instalado desde el registro (`"dsh-eslat": "^2.0.0"`). Para probar
cambios locales sin publicar, instálalo desde la ruta del proyecto con el gestor de plugins: queda
como `link:` y los cambios de `src/` + `node tools/build.mjs` se aplican al recargar la página.

## Activación

Al montarse, el plugin registra el idioma y sus diccionarios, y selecciona **Español** una sola vez,
sustituyendo únicamente el idioma por defecto (`en`). Después:

| Situación | Qué ocurre |
|---|---|
| La interfaz estaba en inglés (por defecto) | Pasa a Español; toda la interfaz cambia |
| Ya estaba en chino u otro idioma elegido | No se toca nada: solo sustituye el idioma por defecto |
| El usuario cambia a otro idioma en Configuración → Idioma | Se respeta para siempre; el plugin no vuelve a forzar el español |
| Un shell nativo vuelve a anunciar su idioma por defecto | El plugin recupera el español, porque la elección no fue del usuario |

La memoria de esa decisión vive en `localStorage` del navegador (`dsh-eslat:activation`). Si el
almacenamiento no está disponible, el plugin selecciona español en cada carga cuando la interfaz está
en inglés.

**Para volver atrás:** Configuración → General → *Idioma* → English. Para desinstalarlo, página
**Plugins**.

## Cobertura

**1.615 de 1.615 claves (100 %) en 36 de 36 namespaces.** La verificación por clave lo garantiza y
falla si alguna falta.

| Grupo | Namespaces | Claves |
|---|---|---:|
| Conversación y chat | `conversation` 367 · `chat` 186 | 553 |
| Trayectoria y entregables | `trajectory` 192 · `deliverables` 60 | 252 |
| Navegación y paneles | `workspace` 112 · `sidebarRight` 34 · `sidebarBrowser` 19 · `sidebarFiles` 11 · `sidebarDocumentPreview` 11 · `sidebar` 5 · `sidebarTerminal` 1 | 193 |
| Ajustes y preferencias | `settings` 34 · `shortcuts` 28 · `permission.access` 17 · `settings.permission` 12 · `settings.theme` 9 | 100 |
| Tareas y automatización | `schedule.manager` 133 · `job` 39 · `workflowRun` 18 · `schedule.catalog` 16 | 206 |
| Herramientas y agentes | `cordis` 51 · `subagent` 39 · `model` 23 · `slash.menu` 9 · `skill` 8 | 130 |
| Comandos y diálogos | `question` 31 · `command` 28 · `feedback` 20 · `plan` 17 · `goal` 12 · `approval` 1 | 109 |
| Base compartida | `common` 41 · `open-in-app` 15 · `reference` 11 · `documentMarkdown` 4 · `settings.locale` 1 | 72 |

## Dialecto

Español neutro de Latinoamérica, con estas decisiones aplicadas en todo el paquete:

| Se usa | En lugar de |
|---|---|
| Configuración | Ajustes |
| presiona / haz clic | pulsa / pincha |
| agregar | añadir |
| computadora, celular | ordenador, móvil |
| archivo | fichero |
| costo | coste |
| `dd/mm/aaaa`, millar con punto (`1.615`) | formato inglés |

Términos que se mantienen: `Bash`, `PowerShell`, `JSON`, `ZIP`, `TTFT`, `tok/s`, `Markdown`,
`Cordis`, `sandbox`, `preset` y los nombres de modelos.

`test/verify.mjs` incluye un **guardián de dialecto**: falla si reaparece un lexema peninsular
(`ordenador`, `fichero`, `puls…`, `añad…`, `vosotros`, `móvil`, `coger`, `pinch…`, `zumo`, `patata`,
`coche`).

## Identidad del plugin

| Capa | Valor | Dónde se define |
|---|---|---|
| Nombre visible | **EsLat** | `locale/{en,es}.json` → `meta.title` |
| Nombre técnico (npm y **id del módulo del navegador**) | `dsh-eslat` | `package.json` → `name` |
| Icono | «Es» sobre «Lat»: degradado azul + cian, 36×36 | `icon.svg` |
| Autor | Amador Aguilar (`@amador_aguilar` en npm, `Amador-Aguilar` en GitHub) | `package.json` → `author` |
| Repositorio | [github.com/Amador-Aguilar/dsh-eslat](https://github.com/Amador-Aguilar/dsh-eslat) | `package.json` → `repository` |

La autoría formal la registra npm al publicar (`npm owner ls dsh-eslat`); la tarjeta de Plugins solo
muestra icono, título y descripción.

## Estructura

```
package.json              manifiesto: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client (platform web)
cordis.patch.yml          capa de parche del bundle: inserta la fila eslat
lib/index.js              mitad Host: inerte, solo mantiene el paquete en el árbol del Loader
lib/client.js             mitad Cliente construida (generada) — todo el comportamiento vive aquí
lib/client.js.map         source map de identidad del bundle
locale/{en,es}.json       título y descripción del plugin en la página Plugins
icon.svg                  icono de la tarjeta (36×36, convención de DSH)
src/<namespace>.es.json   un diccionario por namespace; añadir cobertura es añadir un archivo
src/language.json         definición del idioma: id, etiqueta y respaldo
tools/build.mjs           construye lib/client.js y su map a partir de src/
tools/extract-shipped-keys.mjs   descubre los namespaces de DSH y regenera la instantánea de claves
test/verify.mjs           claves, marcadores, dialecto, frescura del bundle y requisitos de publicación
test/smoke.mjs            ejecuta la mitad Cliente contra dobles de prueba
test/shipped-en.json      instantánea de los diccionarios ingleses de DSH 0.2.0-rc.2
```

Solo se publica la primera mitad: `src/`, `tools/` y `test/` son material del repositorio.

### Por qué la mitad Cliente es un archivo construido

DSH sirve cada plugin del navegador como un bundle *lazy-CJS* ya construido: el host lee
`exports["./client"]` y el navegador evalúa el archivo, que debe estar en la forma del cargador de
módulos (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) y no puede importar nada, porque el
protocolo no admite `require` relativos entre bundles. Por eso los diccionarios viven en `src/` y se
incorporan al bundle generado.

## Desarrollo

```powershell
node tools/build.mjs             # regenera lib/client.js y su map
node test/verify.mjs             # claves, marcadores, dialecto, frescura, publicación
node test/verify.mjs --strict    # además exige cobertura 100 %
node test/smoke.mjs              # comportamiento de la mitad Cliente
node tools/extract-shipped-keys.mjs   # re-descubre los namespaces de la imagen instalada
```

`verify` distingue **errores** (clave inexistente, marcador `{…}` que no cuadra, bundle obsoleto,
lexema peninsular) de **cobertura pendiente**, que informa; `--strict` la exige y es lo que corre
`prepublishOnly`.

`test/shipped-en.json` es una instantánea extraída de DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. Si una versión futura
renombra o añade claves, `node tools/extract-shipped-keys.mjs` refresca la instantánea y `verify`
dice exactamente qué falta.

## Publicar

`prepublishOnly` encadena build + `verify --strict` + smoke, así que no puede salir una versión con
cobertura incompleta.

```powershell
npm run verify     # build + verificación + pruebas
npm publish        # con OTP: npm publish --otp=123456
```

Requisitos que `verify` comprueba: `dsh.bundle.patch` presente, la fila del patch con el nombre del
paquete, `name`/`version` válidos, mitad Cliente construida y en `files`, `engines.dsh`, licencia y
`prepublishOnly`.

## Limitaciones

- **Claves atadas a una versión** — la verificación está anclada a DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. Una clave
  renombrada aguas arriba revierte esa etiqueta al inglés hasta que se actualice el diccionario; el
  extractor y el verificador lo detectan.
- **Los datos no se traducen** — rutas de archivos, descripciones de comandos, resúmenes derivados de
  los argumentos de cada herramienta y la respuesta del modelo siguen en el idioma en que lleguen.
- **Enumeraciones de tres o más elementos** — DSH une los resúmenes cerrados con un separador fijo,
  sin ranura para la conjunción final, así que una lista de tres sale con comas en lugar de «y».
- **Sin reglas de plural propias** — se usan las ranuras `.one`/`.other` que DSH consulta; `es`
  comparte con `en` la regla singular/plural.
- **Sin configuración** — el plugin no declara esquema: activarlo o desactivarlo en la página Plugins
  es el único mando.

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. MIT, exact npm gitHead and repository identity match the fixed commit; engines require DSH at least 0.2.0-rc.2. Same-commit native patch, no-op host and localization client form a two-file local closure. prepublishOnly builds/verifies and runs smoke checks; none were executed. Locale strings containing shell words are not executable process evidence. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

🛰️ dsh-agy-link

DeepSeek Harness × Google Antigravity — 多账号智能池化与官方 agy CLI 驱动桥接 / Multi-Account Pool & Native agy CLI Bridge for DSH

🌟 核心亮点：多账号池化与智能轮换 你拥有多个 Google Antigravity / Gemini 账号？**dsh-agy-link 让多账号管理变得极致简单与自动化**： - 👥 **多账号池化管理 (Account Pool)**：在 DSH 内添加任意数量的 Google 账号（主账号 + 备用账号群），每个账号拥有独立的 HOME 目录沙箱与凭证隔离。 - 🔄 **顺序耗尽故障转移 (Sequential Drain)**：当前账号额度用尽（触发 429 限流或 5h / 周额度耗尽）时，系统**自动平滑接力至下一个可用账号**，对话完全不中断！ - 🕰 **额度到期优先轮换 (Quota-Expiry-First)**：多个账号可用时，优先切换到**重置窗口最早到期**的账号，把"还剩很久才重置"的额度留给后面，整体池化利用率最大化。 - 🧠 **网络抖动智能甄别 (Jitter-Safe Auth)**：代理抖动导致的 keyring 鉴权超时会被自动识别为**可重试的网络错误**而非"登录失效"——基于 agy 本次运行日志的 `keyringAuth` 传输证据精准分类，且粘性"需重新登录"隔离需二次确认，健康账号绝不会被误标。 - 📊 **官方多 Bucket 配额监控 (Multi-Bucket Quota)**：直接调用 Antigravity 官方专用的 `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary` 接口，同时展示 **5小时滚动额度**、**7天周额度**，以及付费 Pro/Ultra 账号专属的 **Gemini 4 Argon 独立周额度池**（不占用普通 Gemini 池）。 - 🔀 **手动切换当前账号 (Manual Switch-Active)**：控制台卡片一键「设为当前使用」，即刻把调度指针钉到指定账号。 - 🔑 **GUI 内浏览器免粘贴登录 (In-GUI Zero-Paste OAuth)**：点击「➕ 添加账号」自动调起系统浏览器，本地回环监听自动捕获授权凭证，**全程无需手动复制粘贴授权码**。 - 🎨 **多主题高对比度自适应 (Light & Dark Themes)**：原生适配 DSH 浅色/深色主题，告别发暗发灰与看不清文字，UI 视觉清晰锐利。 - 🌐 **独立账号网络代理 (Per-Account Proxy)**：支持为每个账号独立绑定 HTTP(S) / SOCKS 代理，避免多账号同 IP 引起风控；未显式配置时自动探测系统代理（macOS `scutil` / Windows 注册表 / Linux gsettings）。 - ⚡ **分模型族独立冷却 (Family-Scoped Cooldown)**：Gemini、Claude、GPT-OSS 与 Argon 的速率限制独立计算，某个模型族受限不影响其他模型族正常调用。 --- ## 🧩 架构与工作原理 1. **短生命周期进程驱动**：每一轮 DSH 对话启动一个独立的官方 `agy -p --output-format stream-json` 进程，解析 NDJSON 事件流。 2. **多账号沙箱机制**：除主账号沿用系统默认 Keychain / HOME 外，所有备用账号在插件私有目录下建立专属 HOME 隔离区，独立写入 agy 格式的标准 OAuth 凭证。Windows 上 agy 的凭据实际存放在机器级 Credential Manager（`gemini:antigravity`），插件因此以「身份级引用计数租约」接管该槽：**同一授权的多个会话并行运行**，只有账号**身份切换**才串行，且由最后一个持有者还原主账号凭据。 3. **多 Bucket 官方配额汇总**：插件定时后台静默轮询官方 `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary`，精准掌控每个账号的 5h 滚动削峰水位、7d 账号阶梯周额度，以及付费账号的 Argon 独立周池。 4. **会话级无缝故障转移**：当遭遇 HTTP 429、额度耗尽或凭证异常时，号池调度器自动标记当前账号家族进入冷却（或按额度到期时间择优轮换），并无缝将后续请求路由到池内下一个有效账号。 5. **失败分类与自愈**：错误按 AUTH / NETWORK / RATE_LIMIT / ELIGIBILITY 等精确分类；网络抖动借由 agy 运行日志自动甄别为可重试故障，绝不误伤健康账号的登录状态。 --- ## ❓ 常见问题排查 (FAQ) ### Windows 平台开始对话时为什么会短暂闪一下黑色命令行窗口（黑框）？ **答：这是 Windows 系统的控制台分配机制，完全良性，不会影响对话和模型功能。** - **原因分析**：DSH 是基于 Electron 的图形桌面应用（GUI 进程），每次发起对话时，插件需要调用底层命令校验并同步当前账号在 Windows 凭据管理器（Credential Manager）中的 OAuth Token，随后启动 `agy.exe` 控制台子进程建立流式通信。在 Windows 11 下，系统默认终端若被设为「Windows 终端 (Windows Terminal)」，Windows Terminal 会拦截后台控制台子进程的句柄分配并闪现弹窗（这是 Windows Terminal 已知的 OpenConsole 委托拦截机制）。 - **解决步骤**： 1. 打开 **Windows 终端 (Windows Terminal)** 的「设置」→「启动」（或进入 Windows「设置」→「系统」→「开发者选项」）。 2. 将 **默认终端应用程序 (Default terminal application)** 从「让 Windows 决定」或「Windows 终端」更改为 **「Windows 控制台主机 (Windows Console Host)」**。 3. 点击右下角 **保存 (Save)**。 4. **完全退出并重启 DSH**（使新启动的主进程应用更新后的控制台委托注册表），黑框闪烁即可彻底消除。 --- ## via `--add-dir` | | 🤝 **`agy_ask` Delegation** | Allows other DSH models to delegate subtasks to Antigravity models | | ⌨️ **`/agy` Commands** | Full command suite: `status`, `pool`, `auth`, `models`, `mode`, `effort`, `workspace`, `goal`, `session`, `enable-account`, `disable-account`, `clear`, `doctor`, `help` | --- ## 📋 Prerequisites | Requirement | Details | | --- | --- | | **1. System Proxy / VPN** | **【Required in restricted regions】** (TUN mode or `HTTPS_PROXY` environment variable to ensure Google endpoints are reachable) | | **2. DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** | Your current DSH environment (`dsh --version`) | | **3. Node.js ≥ 24** | Required runtime (`node --version`) | | **4. Google Antigravity `agy` CLI** | Installed per [Google's official guide](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/install). Verified with `agy --version` | --- ## 🚀 Quick Start ```bash # 0. Ensure System Proxy / TUN mode is active (required for Google connectivity): export HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 # 1. Install plugin: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agy-link # Upgrade to latest: # dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agy-link@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org # 2. Start DSH Web GUI, test status: # /agy status # 3. Add accounts: # Click "AGY (n)" badge in the top header, click "➕ Add Account" and complete browser login. # 4. Select an Antigravity model in /model and start chatting! ``` --- ## ⚙️ Configuration | Key | Environment Variable | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `DSH_AGY_ENABLED` | `true` | Master switch | | `agyBin` | `DSH_AGY_BIN` | auto-detected | Path to `agy` binary | | `permissionMode` | `DSH_AGY_MODE` | `skip` | `skip` (unattended execution) / `plan` / `accept-edits` | | `defaultModel` | `DSH_AGY_DEFAULT_MODEL` | `(agy default)` | Default model slug | | `defaultEffort` | `DSH_AGY_DEFAULT_EFFORT` | `(model default)` | Thinking budget: `low` / `medium` / `high` | | `hiddenModels` | `DSH_AGY_HIDDEN_MODELS` | `[]` | Model slugs hidden from the `/model` picker (deny-list, newly discovered models stay visible; manage them via the "Model visibility" row in the settings panel) | | `timeoutMs` | `DSH_AGY_TIMEOUT_MS` | `600000` | Activity watchdog timeout in milliseconds | | `longToolIdleMinutes` | `DSH_AGY_LONG_TOOL_IDLE_MINUTES` | `240` | Idle budget while a tool step is ACTIVE (minutes); `0` keeps the normal `timeoutMs` budget so wedged tools fail fast | | `workspaceRoot` | `DSH_AGY_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | session cwd | Working directory root | --- ## Headless operation See [Headless permissions](docs/HEADLESS-PERMISSIONS.md) for a bounded reproduction, least-privilege read-rule validation, and process-versus-tool acceptance checks. The plugin passes the selected permission mode to `agy`; it does not approve, deny, or bypass permissions itself. In headless/print operation, `agy` can automatically deny a tool request in `plan` or `accept-edits`. The raw tool error is retained in `/agy status`; it is not proof of a human denial. Do not assume undocumented wildcard semantics for either mode. Test the exact `agy` version and command set in a scoped workspace. Choose `skip` only when you explicitly accept unattended tool execution. --- ## ❓ FAQ & Troubleshooting ### Why does a black command prompt / terminal window briefly flash when starting a conversation on Windows? **A: This is a cosmetic behavior of the Windows Console subsystem and is completely harmless.** - **Root Cause**: DSH is an Electron desktop app (GUI process). Before each conversation turn, the plugin verifies/syncs Google credentials via the Windows Credential Manager and launches the `agy.exe` console child process for streaming. On Windows 11, if the system default terminal is set to "Windows Terminal", Windows Terminal intercepts the background console allocation and momentarily flashes an empty window (a known Windows Terminal OpenConsole delegation behavior). - **Solution**: 1. Open **Windows Terminal** → **Settings** → **Startup** (or Windows **Settings** → **System** → **For developers**). 2. Change **Default terminal application** from "Let Windows decide" or "Windows Terminal" to **"Windows Console Host"**. 3. Click **Save** in the bottom-right corner. 4. **Completely exit and restart DSH** so the running host process picks up the updated console delegation setting. --- ## ⚠️ Disclaimer This plugin operates strictly by invoking the official, unmodified `agy` CLI binary installed on your local system. Use of this plugin is subject to Google Antigravity's Terms of Service. ## License MIT License.

# dsh-WallpaperAndCost

A merged DSH web plugin combining **wallpaper customization** and the **DeepSeek balance & usage widget**.

## Features

### 🎨 Wallpaper (壁纸)
- 8 built-in curated gradients (暮色 / 深渊 / 晨曦 / 森林 / 星夜 / 暖阳 / 青空 / 石墨)
- Upload your own images **at full original resolution** (no compression), stored in IndexedDB
- **动态壁纸：上传 MP4/WebM 视频，自动静音循环播放**（铺底 `<video>` 元素，object-fit: cover）
- Crop editor: drag to pan + zoom (100%–250%) with a live viewport-proportional preview
- Independent **absolute opacity sliders (0–100%)** for the left sidebar, the conversation column and the right sidebar — the right-sidebar slider now drives **both** the dsh-better-sidebar panel *and* DSH's official right sidebar (dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right, detected via `[data-sidebar-right-panel]`); the slider auto-appears whenever either sidebar is present
- Wallpaper choice persists across restarts (localStorage + IndexedDB)
- **创意工坊壁纸提取（服务器目录）**：输入 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊条目文件夹的绝对路径（`…steamapps\workshop\content\431960\<id>`），由内置的 `scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py` 解析 `scene.pkg` / `.tex`（含 LZ4 解压、DXT/RGBA→PNG、内嵌 MP4），提取最佳壁纸供预览与下载。需要运行 DSH 的机器装有 Python 3（脚本为纯 Python，Pillow 可选）。
  - **桌面端支持「选择文件夹…」**：DSH Desktop（Windows）上可直接用系统原生文件夹选择器选取条目文件夹，自动填入绝对路径，避免手输/粘贴路径出错而报"文件夹不存在"。
  - **路径自动规整 + 明确报错**：路径会先去空白、剥成对引号、展开 `~`，并校验是否为绝对路径；读取失败会区分「文件夹不存在」「没有权限读取该文件夹（含 Windows 受控文件夹访问拦截）」「路径不是文件夹」，不再把权限问题笼统报成"文件夹不存在"。

### 🔍 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊提取脚本
- 仓库自带独立脚本 `scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py`，可单独命令行使用：
  ```sh
  python scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py --folder <创意工坊条目文件夹> --out <输出目录>
  python scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py <scene.pkg>          # 或直接解析单个 pkg
  python scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py <scene.pkg> --list   # 只列出包内文件
  ```
- 支持容器：PKGV（scene.pkg）、TEXV0005/TEXI0001/TEXB000x（.tex）。内容类型：内嵌 JPEG/MP4、DXT1/3/5→.dds（有 Pillow 转 .png）、RGBA8888/R8 裸像素→.png、其余文件原样导出。
- 浏览器端另有无需 Python 的「从 Wallpaper 导入」入口（File System Access API 纯 JS 解包），两者互补。

### 💰 Balance & usage (余额与用量)
- Balance button in the conversation header: balance, today's consumption, this session's token usage & estimated cost
- Official DeepSeek CNY price table with peak/valley windows, per-model and per-window breakdown
- Platform consumption (`DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_TOKEN`) is read from DSH's credential store by the host (`ctx.credentials.resolve`), the same way `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` are — no in-widget token capture
- The DeepSeek API key never leaves the host (host-side routes only)

### 🟢 OpenCode Go 用量 (rolling / weekly / monthly)
- 会话头部新增一个 `Go` 按钮（与余额按钮并列于顶端）：默认只显示**滚动 / 周 / 月**三个用量的百分比
- 点开后用**进度条**展示每个窗口用量，并显示各自的**重置时间**，以及上次刷新时间与实际使用的密钥名
- **刷新时机跟随两条 Go 路由的请求**：`opencodego`（自建供应商）与 `opencode-go`（DSH 官方供应商）任一发出请求（会话事件里的 `assistant/message` 或 `request/header` 带 `provider`），宿主就把用量版本号 +1，前端下次轮询才去上游拉一次；没有请求时前端每 5 秒问的只是本地宿主，宿主直接回缓存（不一定打上游）。点开面板会强刷一次（`?force=1`）
- 快照缓存 5 分钟保质、4 秒内合并连发的刷新；上游临时取不到时继续显示上次结果并给出提醒，不会把面板清空
- 数据来自 OpenCode Go 官方用量接口 `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`（Bearer 鉴权），由 host 端代理，key 通过 `ctx.credentials.resolve` 按 `OPENCODEGO_API_KEY` → `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` 顺序解析（前者 401/403 时自动退回后者），**从不入源码/浏览器**
- 该接口为社区发现的非官方文档化接口，响应结构可能随 OpenCode 变动；窗口解析做了兼容（`usage.` 前缀或裸窗口、`resetsAt` 或 `resetsInSeconds`）

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-WallpaperAndCost
```

or from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-WallpaperAndCost
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

## Requirements
- DSH web profile
- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential (设置 → 模型) for the balance feature
- Optional `DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_TOKEN` (set in 设置 → 模型) for exact platform consumption figures
- `OPENCODEGO_API_KEY`（自建 `opencodego` 供应商）或 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`（官方 `opencode-go` 供应商）之一，用于 Go 用量面板

## Structure
- `lib/index.js` — host half: balance/cost API routes (`/api/deepseek-balance`, `/api/deepseek-session-cost`) + workshop extraction routes (`/api/wallpaper-workshop/extract`, `/api/wallpaper-workshop/file`) + OpenCode Go usage route (`/api/opencode-go-usage`, 支持 `?force=1`；刷新由 `opencodego` / `opencode-go` 的会话请求驱动)
- `lib/client.js` — browser half: wallpaper + balance widget + OpenCode usage widget + workshop extraction UI (no build step required)
- `scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py` — standalone Wallpaper Engine `.pkg`/`.tex` extraction engine (called by the host route; also usable as a CLI)
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch mounting the plugin row

## License
MIT

# @askdkc/dsh-auth English | [日本語](README.ja.md) > Provider authentication for [dsh-cli](https://github.com/askdkc/dsh-cli) and > [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Use **ChatGPT, Claude, SuperGrok, OpenCode Zen/Go, OpenRouter, Nous Portal, and Infron** as model providers with OAuth, device code, or an API key according to the provider. No dsh source patch is needed. This plugin is developed alongside (and bundled into) [dsh-cli](https://github.com/askdkc/dsh-cli), the terminal front door for DeepSeek Harness; it also installs standalone into any dsh profile. ``` dsh-cli → /provider → Provider authentication → sign in /auth login openai-codex ← the plugin command /model → OpenAI Codex → gpt-5.6-sol ← routes & models ``` **Status: experimental.** Catalog OAuth flows are [pi-ai](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-ai)'s shipped implementations (device-code and loopback callback included); this plugin adds the hosting: credential storage, automatic token refresh, adapter registration, and a login surface over the `userQuestions` seam that works in the TUI, the web client, and refuses cleanly on headless hosts. ## Install **With dsh-cli** — nothing to do: dsh-auth ships inside the dsh-cli package (bundled dependency). Update dsh-cli and the `/provider` wizard gains its provider authentication branch automatically. **Standalone, into any dsh profile:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile add @askdkc/dsh-auth ``` Then restart the host; `/` lists `auth`, and every model picker gains the signed-in providers' catalogs (credential-gated — see below). ## What it does - Mounts pi-ai catalog providers as `llm` registry routes: `openai-codex`, `anthropic`, `xai`, and `openrouter`. OpenCode Zen/Go use an owned DSH adapter with bundled Messages, Responses, Chat Completions and Google transports. **Models appear in a picker only after that provider is signed in** (credential-gated listing) — sign in and the catalog appears, sign out and it disappears. Verified current models stay resolvable after logout; retired models fail explicitly and never trigger an automatic switch. - Loads those Provider objects from the exact pi-ai dependency owned by the installed `dsh-llm-pi-ai`. rc and alpha hosts therefore keep their supported pi-ai versions without passing Provider objects across package instances. - `/auth login [provider]` runs the selected authentication method interactively. The waiting panel behaves the way pi's host does: the authorization URL is **opened in your browser automatically** (never hand-copied — the URL is hundreds of characters and wrap artifacts corrupt its `redirect_uri`), and the panel offers *Copy authorization link* / *Open browser again* / *Cancel sign-in*. Device-code flows open the verification page and make the short code the copy target. OpenAI Codex also offers a device-code login method — the most robust path on headless or locked-down machines (no localhost:1455 callback needed). - OpenCode Zen/Go accept API keys. OpenRouter offers pi-ai's OAuth PKCE flow or a manual API key. `nous` and `infron` use Chat Completions; their `/models` listings must provide capacity and pricing metadata before a model is selectable. `nous` offers device-code OAuth and an explicitly selected manual Bearer token compatibility path. The latter has not been validated against a real Nous account. - Stored access tokens refresh automatically before each request, serialized per provider under the credential store's lock — concurrent requests never double-refresh a rotated token. - `/auth status` / `/auth logout `; the `ctx.dshAuth` service exposes the same api for UIs (the dsh-cli `/provider` wizard and `/login` ride it). ## Usage ``` /auth # status: which providers are signed in /auth login # pick a provider interactively /auth login openai-codex # ChatGPT (Plus/Pro) /auth login anthropic # Claude (Pro/Max) /auth login xai # SuperGrok / X Premium /auth login opencode # OpenCode Zen API key /auth login opencode-go # OpenCode Go API key /auth login openrouter # OAuth PKCE or API key /auth login nous # device code or manual Bearer /auth login infron # Infron API key /auth logout anthropic /auth models opencode # source, last success, excluded models /auth refresh opencode # immediate catalog refresh ``` Model requests against a provider you have not signed in to fail loudly with the `/auth login ` hint — never silently. ## Configuration ```yaml - id: dsh-auth name: '@askdkc/dsh-auth' config: providers: [openai-codex, anthropic, xai, opencode, opencode-go, openrouter, nous, infron] nous: clientId: hermes-cli # infron: # serviceTier: flex # standard or flex; omit for gateway defaults # credentialsFile: /secure/path/credentials.json ``` - `credentialsFile` defaults to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-auth/credentials.json` (`~/.dsh/dsh-auth/credentials.json`), overridable with the `DSH_AUTH_CREDENTIALS` environment variable. The directory is created `0700`, the file `0600` (best-effort on Windows), and every write is atomic (temp file + rename). - Aliases `opencode-zen`, `hermes`, and `infron.ai` resolve to `opencode`, `nous`, and `infron`. Credentials are stored under canonical IDs. - The Nous client ID defaults to `hermes-cli`; third-party reuse of this ID is not guaranteed by Nous. Set `nous.clientId` if your deployment has its own. - Set `infron.serviceTier` to `standard` or `flex` to select the routing tier for all Infron models, including `z-ai/glm-5.3`. Requests send `{"provider":{"service_tier":"flex"}}` at the body root; there is no `extra_body` wrapper on the wire. Omit the setting to keep gateway defaults. Flex may fall back to Standard when unavailable; see the [Infron API reference](https://models.infron.ai/models/z-ai/glm-5.3/api-reference). - A route another adapter family already owns — an `llm-pi-ai` settings profile naming the same provider — is refused by the registry; the plugin logs the refusal and mounts the remaining routes. Keep one provider on one adapter. - OpenCode Zen/Go own their catalog and transports independently of the host's pi version. Official `/models` rosters and exact-route models.dev metadata refresh hourly. Startup uses the verified cache or bundled snapshot immediately. `/auth models [provider]` shows freshness and excluded model reasons; `/auth refresh [provider]` requests an update. Failed updates keep the last verified catalog. Unsupported or incomplete models are excluded individually; no sibling metadata or another route's prices are guessed. - Public catalog caches live at `$DSH_HOME/dsh-auth/catalog-v1/` and contain no credentials. Existing provider IDs, API keys and capacity overrides are retained. A new wire protocol requires a package update; new IDs on supported protocols do not require a pi update. - In auth 0.2, pi-specific construction helpers are internal to `pi-routes`; consumers should use `DshAuthApi` and the DSH adapter contract. ## Security notes - The credential file holds **API keys and long-lived refresh tokens**. It is never logged, never echoed through status surfaces (`/auth status` shows expiry metadata only), and a corrupt file fails loudly instead of being overwritten. - dsh-cli masks API-key input and redacts it from questionnaire summaries. - Login refuses to run where no interactive surface is registered (no browser/GUI assumptions — remote and headless hosts get a clear error, per the ecosystem spec's remote-determinism rule, TUI-RUN-001). - Subscription authentication and API-key access are different products: ChatGPT Codex and Claude Pro/Max use their subscription backends; the new API-key routes use each service's API backend. ## Development ```sh pnpm install pnpm verify # build + headless smoke (credential store, refresh # serialization, prompt bridging, gating, service api) ``` The smoke suite runs without cordis or a harness: the pure modules are exercised directly. Real end-to-end login needs an interactive host (dsh-cli) and is verified manually per release. The plugin is developed in the [dsh-cli repository](https://github.com/askdkc/dsh-cli) in the tracked `dsh-auth/` directory. Auth and CLI changes can be committed together. The initial in-repository snapshot came from [dsh-auth-fork](https://github.com/askdkc/dsh-auth-fork) commit `a48e59ec502fa0a3238c78955ffcffdfa8ae5abb`. Development and releases of this copy are now managed in dsh-cli. ## Roadmap - **M2** *(landed)* — dsh-cli integration: `/provider` OAuth branch, `/login` account section, two-level `/model` picker with a pinned recently-used group. - **M3** — `dsh-ecosystem-spec` conformance (manifest validation, admission fixtures) plus the remaining pi-ai OAuth providers (GitHub Copilot, Kimi); community list entry. - **M4** — Gemini: a custom Google device-code flow (pi-ai ships none; this is the one wheel this project plans to build itself). ## License [MIT](LICENSE). The original ccch1mneyyy copyright notice is retained; dkc is listed for the fork's independent development.

# dsh-cli > An interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness. This is dkc's independently developed fork of [dsh-TUI by chimney](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI). ## Preview
## Highlights - Streaming Markdown, tool cards, images, Mermaid diagrams, and keyboard completion. - A pixel whale, live work status, context bar, TPS gauge, and clickable timeline. - Session management with resume, fork, rewind, background work, and export. - DSH presets, skills, MCP, goals, subagents, provider authentication, and extensions. - Authentication for OpenAI, Claude, OpenCode, OpenRouter, Hermes Agent, and Infron. - Virtualized rendering and bounded caches for long sessions. - Optional scoped code analysis through the separate LSP provider; see [code-analysis setup and current acceptance limits](docs/code-intelligence.en.md). ## Quick Start Requires [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en) `>=22.19.0`, pnpm 11, a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) source checkout with dependencies installed, and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. We aim to support current DSH APIs. Compatibility is checked against installed packages and the upstream default branch, without a release allowlist; see [ADAPTER.md](ADAPTER.md). Clone recursively to fetch submodules. In an existing checkout, run `git submodule update --init --recursive` before installation. ```sh git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/askdkc/dsh-cli.git cd dsh-cli pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm build node scripts/with-publish-manifest.mjs npm pack --ignore-scripts TARBALL="$PWD/askdkc-dsh-cli-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz" cd ~/DIR/TO/deepseek-harness pnpm dsh plugin --profile dsh-cli add "@askdkc/dsh-cli@file:${TARBALL}" pnpm dsh --profile dsh-cli ``` Replace `~/DIR/TO/deepseek-harness` with your checkout path. The first interactive launch registers `dsh-cli`; open a new shell, then run it from your project directory. The managed command saves the built Harness checkout path, so a separate global DSH installation is unnecessary. Harness `plugin add` refreshes an existing managed command during updates; no manual registration is needed. An explicit `DSH_CLI_DSH_ROOT` overrides the saved path. To update this fork, rebuild and reinstall the tarball. `/update` uses the registry. Use the named `@askdkc/dsh-cli@file:...` form for local tarball updates. A bare tarball path can fail with `ENOENT` when pnpm resolves a previous `file:` dependency whose archive has been deleted. `TARBALL` holds the archive's absolute path; pass it to the install command instead of executing it. For PATH setup and install issues, see [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md). ## Use `Enter` sends, `Tab` completes, `Ctrl+Enter` interrupts and sends, and double `Esc` rewinds. # dsh-cli > An interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness. This is dkc's independently developed fork of [dsh-TUI by chimney](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI). ## Preview
## Highlights - Streaming Markdown, tool cards, images, Mermaid diagrams, and keyboard completion. - A pixel whale, live work status, context bar, TPS gauge, and clickable timeline. - Session management with resume, fork, rewind, background work, and export. - DSH presets, skills, MCP, goals, subagents, provider authentication, and extensions. - Authentication for OpenAI, Claude, OpenCode, OpenRouter, Hermes Agent, and Infron. - Virtualized rendering and bounded caches for long sessions. - Optional scoped code analysis through the separate LSP provider; see [code-analysis setup and current acceptance limits](docs/code-intelligence.en.md). ## Quick Start Requires [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en) `>=22.19.0`, pnpm 11, a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) source checkout with dependencies installed, and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. We aim to support current DSH APIs. Compatibility is checked against installed packages and the upstream default branch, without a release allowlist; see [ADAPTER.md](ADAPTER.md). Clone recursively to fetch submodules. In an existing checkout, run `git submodule update --init --recursive` before installation. ```sh git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/askdkc/dsh-cli.git cd dsh-cli pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm build node scripts/with-publish-manifest.mjs npm pack --ignore-scripts TARBALL="$PWD/askdkc-dsh-cli-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz" cd ~/DIR/TO/deepseek-harness pnpm dsh plugin --profile dsh-cli add "@askdkc/dsh-cli@file:${TARBALL}" pnpm dsh --profile dsh-cli ``` Replace `~/DIR/TO/deepseek-harness` with your checkout path. The first interactive launch registers `dsh-cli`; open a new shell, then run it from your project directory. The managed command saves the built Harness checkout path, so a separate global DSH installation is unnecessary. Harness `plugin add` refreshes an existing managed command during updates; no manual registration is needed. An explicit `DSH_CLI_DSH_ROOT` overrides the saved path. To update this fork, rebuild and reinstall the tarball. `/update` uses the registry. Use the named `@askdkc/dsh-cli@file:...` form for local tarball updates. A bare tarball path can fail with `ENOENT` when pnpm resolves a previous `file:` dependency whose archive has been deleted. `TARBALL` holds the archive's absolute path; pass it to the install command instead of executing it. For PATH setup and install issues, see [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md). ## Use `Enter` sends, `Tab` completes, `Ctrl+Enter` interrupts and sends, and double `Esc` rewinds. Press `?` for shortcuts. The working-status line follows each accepted request in English, Japanese, or Chinese. Ambiguous short requests keep that session's previous progress language; `/lang` controls the rest of the interface separately. `/resume` opens the session manager; `/auth` connects providers and `/model` selects a model. `/bg` keeps a session running until the TUI exits. See [Interaction and commands](docs/interaction.en.md) for the full reference. `/model` opens a centered picker with Favorites, Recent, and provider sections. `/model seek deep` opens it with an order-independent search; an exact `/model provider/model-id` switches directly. In the picker, use `Ctrl+F` to toggle a favorite, `Ctrl+A` to connect a provider, and `Esc` to close. To import Claude Code, Codex, OMP, zcode, or Grok Build conversations, run `dsh-cli migrate` to see available histories, then `dsh-cli migrate [--dry-run]`. Tool traffic is not imported. See [Session migration](docs/migrate.en.md). ## Documentation - [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md) · [VS Code](docs/vscode.en.md) - [Interaction](docs/interaction.en.md) · [Configuration](docs/configuration.en.md) · [Themes](docs/themes.en.md) - [Architecture and limitations](docs/architecture.en.md) · [All docs](docs/README.md) - [Plugin development](docs/plugins.en.md) · [Contributing](docs/contributing.en.md) ## Acknowledgments The pixel whale's 22 hand-drawn frames and idle animations come from [dsh-ui-whale](https://github.com/lhh010/dsh-ui-whale) by [@lhh010](https://github.com/lhh010) (BSD-3-Clause). Thank you for the art and inspiration 🐋💜 Community projects and companion tools: [Friends' links](docs/links.md). ## License [MIT](LICENSE). # dsh-working-activity input-language fork This local fork starts from `dsh-working-activity` 0.5.0 (BSD-3-Clause). It adds Japanese progress copy and a per-session `lang: input` mode. The original `auto`, `zh`, and `en` modes retain their behavior. The dsh-cli workspace links this package locally; its source manifest names `@askdkc/dsh-working-activity@0.5.0-input.0` through an npm alias. Build with `npm run build:working-activity` from the dsh-cli root. The publish-manifest helper bundles the compiled fork under the runtime dependency name, so an external dsh-cli installation does not need a separate fork release. `client-snapshot/` is the unchanged 0.5.0 Web client bundle and declarations. The build copies it into `lib/` after compiling the server side, so a fresh checkout still has the existing optional Web entry. This change targets the TUI; Web client language-aware ticking is not expanded here.

User-configured AI API endpoints and vendored provider OAuth flows through Kiokuko Models
credentials: Optional user-provided GitHub or embedding credentials; never bundled or persisted by the plugin

TYPESAFE_API_KEY resolved per explicit call; optional DSH-managed set/unset via /kioku-typesafe-key, inherited environment precedence, no worker or Kiokuko storage exposure; input visible while typing
Optional separate Nimble bearer credential reference through DSH; TYPESAFE_API_KEY is prohibited for Nimble; credentials are never persisted in decision records
Shared dsh-auth credentials: human Web login/key replacement/logout; logout also affects dsh-cli
failureBoundaries: Repository identity, run identity, lease, revision, and integrity mismatches fail closed
Remote embedding is disabled by default and unavailable services do not become normal success
Ordinary memory finalization failures are retryable; uncertain Deep requests are never automatically resent. Neither can veto completion or session-log export
AgenticReplay is configured by default; capture requires a session choice or start command, adds no network transmission, and cannot veto native outcomes

Explicitly enrolled bounded TDD units fail closed on absent/invalid guardrail artifacts or stale authority/receipt bindings; only Linux x64 has native engine verification, other bundled targets are cross-built
lifecycleEvidence: prepare runs only npm run build
Git installs use repository-scoped pnpm allowBuilds approval on a supporting pnpm version; source revision pinning is optional and separate
Disposable-profile install, Web start, and uninstall evidence is recorded by CI

# Kiokuko(記憶庫) DeepSeek Harness Plugin
[日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md)

Kiokuko adds memory, planning, verification, and observability to
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Memory is optional. After a task ends, Kiokuko asks whether to organize recorded experience, shows an ephemeral preview, and saves only the exact revision the user approves. Automatic memory writers are retired. [Review, recall and forgetting](docs/replay-memory-review.md).

Inspect sources and corrections with `/kioku-memory explain ENTRY_ID`; explicitly forget a memory with `/kioku-memory forget ENTRY_ID --revision N`. [Evidence, explanations and forgetting](docs/memory-evidence.md).

## Features

- **Kiokuko Models** — Connect and authenticate from Web Settings or `/kiokuko model`, independently of native Models settings. Includes Infron Standard/Flex. [Setup and shared credentials](docs/kiokuko-models.md)
- **Execution modes** — Choose normal execution or 役小角(enno-oduno) for role-based planning and verification. [Details](docs/model-selection.md)
- **Project memory** — Retrieve useful project knowledge for later work. [Concepts](docs/concepts.md)
- **Deep planning** — Run bounded, read-only investigation with four roles. [Usage](docs/deep-planning.md)
- **DSH subagents** — The standard preset provides `subagent` and `subagent_fork`; native children do not repeat Kiokuko's execution-mode choice. [Configuration](docs/dsh-plugin.md#subagents)
- **Continuity** — Disabled by default. Set `continuity.mode: active` to summarize recent execution evidence for the model. [Setup](docs/continuity.md)


- **AgenticReplay** — Record model/tool activity and export it as HTML. [Settings and commands](docs/agenticreplay-recording.md)
- **Japanese output** — Give supported models a bundled Skill for natural Japanese. [Details](docs/japanese-output.md)

Tool exposure defaults to `auto`: task type and current phase determine the Kiokuko model tools shown. Native tools stay available; `full` is an explicit compatibility override. See [tool exposure](docs/tool-exposure.md).

## Install and use

Runtime compatibility target: **DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2**, with the `web` and `dsh-cli` profiles. See the [verification scope](docs/dsh-plugin.md#compatibility).

Requires Node.js **24.16.0+** and pnpm.
From the DSH source directory, install and start the Web profile:

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add kiokuko-dsh
pnpm dsh web
```

Install and start the CLI profile:

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile dsh-cli add @askdkc/dsh-cli
pnpm dsh plugin --profile dsh-cli add kiokuko-dsh
pnpm dsh --profile dsh-cli
```

If you use a globally installed `dsh` CLI, omit `pnpm` from the commands.
Enter your task normally; no Kiokuko setup command is needed.
For GitHub/local installation, see the [plugin guide](docs/dsh-plugin.md).

Recordings keep `capture.content: redacted` by default. To minimize body storage, select `agenticReplay.capture.content: metadata`; raw capture is unavailable. Known credential assignments, quoted values, authentication headers and URL credentials are removed while ordinary text remains. This does not detect every secret or rewrite earlier traces and exports; managing earlier files is a separate user action.

## Update

Stop DSH, then update and restart the Web profile:

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web update kiokuko-dsh --latest
pnpm dsh web
```

Stop DSH, then update and restart the CLI profile:

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile dsh-cli update kiokuko-dsh --latest
pnpm dsh --profile dsh-cli
```

To update a release published within the last 24 hours, disable pnpm 11's default
[`minimumReleaseAge`](https://pnpm.io/settings/dependency-resolution#minimumreleaseage)
check for Kiokuko and its dependencies. Confirm that the second command prints `0`,
then update:

```bash
pnpm config set --location=global --json minimumReleaseAge 0
pnpm config get minimumReleaseAge
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web update kiokuko-dsh --latest
pnpm dsh plugin --profile dsh-cli update kiokuko-dsh --latest
```

This setting persists globally and disables the release-age check for future pnpm
installs and updates as well. Restart DSH after the update succeeds.

At startup, all seventeen bundled Skills (including Japanese output) and their references are synchronized to `~/.agents/skills/`. Missing files are created and managed copies are updated; unmanaged files are preserved. Other agents must reload their Skill catalog.

These are the full-package defaults. The [configured core and optional modules](docs/core-modules.md) build ships only selected resources; core alone provides conversation, research, writing and project memory without Enno/Lisp runtimes.

Startup also refreshes an existing Kiokuko managed block in the startup directory’s `AGENTS.md`, preserving your other instructions. Restart DSH after updating the package. See [setup and verification](docs/dsh-plugin.md#what-setup-updates-and-when) for another workspace or stale copies; `kiokuko use` is not the DSH setup command.

The `agenticreplay` distribution uses `>=0.1.0 <1.0.0`, so future patch and minor releases
can be installed by an explicit dependency update without changing the range.
Lockfiles retain the tested versions until updated. Restart DSH afterward.
When upgrading from OrcaReplay, rename explicit `orca` settings to `agenticReplay`;
saved session choices survive and legacy traces are retained but not imported.
[Update details](docs/dsh-plugin.md#update) · [Recording upgrade](docs/agenticreplay-recording.md#upgrade-from-orcareplay)

If existing chats fail with an unknown `kiokuko/` event, see [history repair](docs/session-history-repair.md).

If Kiokuko fails to load after a DSH update, see [startup recovery](docs/dsh-plugin.md#startup-failure-after-a-dsh-update) for profile-specific update and reinstall commands. Keep session logs and the Kiokuko database; reinstallation cannot fix every API incompatibility.

[Documentation](docs/README.md) · [Permissions](PERMISSIONS.md) · [MIT license](LICENSE)
## Optional Common Lisp tools

Install SBCL first:

- macOS: `brew install sbcl`
- Debian / Ubuntu: `sudo apt install sbcl`
- Arch Linux: `sudo pacman -S sbcl`

Add this to the `kiokuko-dsh` row in the selected profile’s
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (`web` or `dsh-cli`)
(keep other `config` values), then reload the plugin. Each implementation task
shows its Goal, items and observable checks before asking whether to use Lisp.
The choice belongs to that task and scope; a new task asks again.
You can also enable it with `/kioku-lisp enable`.
Check it with `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config`, using the same profile name.

```yaml
- id: kiokuko-dsh
  config:
    lisp:
      enabled: true
      sbclPath: sbcl
```

The default development mode does not require Bubblewrap. The explicit protected compatibility mode does on Linux.
Choose “使う” to use Lisp, “使わない” to use ordinary tools, or “取消・作業を保持” to cancel while preserving prepared work. Closing the question leaves implementation pending. Lisp choice and normal/Enno selection are separate. A failed Lisp startup remains a recoverable blocker until the selected route works or you explicitly change it.
Ordinary edits and tests run without further confirmation after that choice. Source/data deletion and existing durable user database mutation require a concrete review. Lisp and ordinary tools coexist. Completion requires current item evidence and a fresh final check through the user’s entry point. See [Goal-driven coding](docs/coding-workflow.md) and [owned execution, receipts and memory reuse](docs/owned-execution.md).
See [setup, APIs, limits and recovery](docs/lisp.md).

## Typed decisions (Jev / Laya / Nimble)

Optional [automatic model selection](docs/model-selection.md#automatic-model-selection) chooses a validated `openai-codex` model and reasoning effort for a new normal task. It defaults to `modelAutoMode.mode: off`; `/kioku-model-auto on | observe | off | status` changes only the current session. `observe` measures a proposal without changing the model. It requires a ready Jev or Laya backend, dsh-codex, native model metadata and a token meter. Failed or unavailable classification keeps the current model; manual model selection takes priority.

[Answer review](docs/answer-review.md) is enabled by default on the full plugin and modular core. It evaluates an already displayed normal answer using the configured Jev, Laya or Nimble provider and may ask the same main model to reconsider once. The defaults are:

```yaml
answerReview:
  mode: auto
  budgetMs: 5000
```

Set `answerReview.mode: off` to disable it. It inherits `typedDecisions`, adds evaluation inference (and at most one main-model turn), and does not delay the first answer. If the selected provider is unavailable, review is skipped and the original answer is preserved; no other provider is substituted. Laya v1 findings are unverified suggestions because worker-side truncation cannot be checked. `/kioku-decisions status` reports progress and skip reasons; it does not certify correctness.


Jev is the default. Switch in DSH's command input without editing configuration or restarting DSH:

```text
/kioku-decisions use jev
/kioku-decisions use laya
/kioku-decisions use nimble
/kioku-decisions use default
```

Laya connects directly to the existing worker started by `start-laya`; no worker replacement or fingerprint setup is needed. Jev needs a TypeSafe key; Nimble needs an endpoint and model configured first. A successful probe saves the selection for this project and applies it to new requests. It survives restarts and preserves in-flight request bindings. `use default` restores the plugin configuration.

Set the API key in DSH's `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` if set), or use `/kioku-typesafe-key YOUR_KEY`. Keep any existing entries:

```yaml
version: 1
refs:
  TYPESAFE_API_KEY: YOUR_KEY
```

If creating the YAML file yourself, run `chmod 600 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (use `$DSH_HOME` if set).

In the DSH command UI, check the key and test the connection:

```text
/kioku-typesafe-key status
/kioku-decisions probe
/kioku-decisions status
```

`probe` sends a synthetic API request; `status` does not. `/kioku-typesafe-key clear` removes the stored key. Key input is visible when using `/kioku-typesafe-key YOUR_KEY`. See [typed decisions](docs/typed-decisions.md) and the [explicit Lisp API](docs/typesafe.md) for more.

Jev remains the default. Nimble and local [Laya-CoreML](docs/laya-coreml.md) are optional alternatives; Laya connects directly to `~/Library/Caches/laya-coreml/worker.sock` using the existing v1 `health`/`predict` protocol. `/kioku-decisions install-laya` reuses a running worker or shows setup instructions.

Use `aac6fef/laya-multilingual-coreml` for English and other languages. Its 1,024-token input capacity includes the question, options and state; the `-ane` variant allows only 96 tokens. See the [upstream model specifications](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml#available-checkpoints). After the [initial setup](docs/Laya-CoreML-ja.md), use the following commands. Stop any running Laya worker before starting it with the new model; `LAYA_MODEL` also overrides the old default in an existing worker script.

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/laya-coreml/multilingual
hf download \
  aac6fef/laya-multilingual-coreml \
  --local-dir ~/.local/share/laya-coreml/multilingual
LAYA_MODEL="$HOME/.local/share/laya-coreml/multilingual" start-laya
```

## Semantic memory reuse

[Semantic memory reuse](docs/memory-reuse.md) checks existing retrieval candidates
against the current request after a synthetic provider probe succeeds. Embeddings
are optional; `memoryReuse.mode: off` disables this additional selection.

[Memory application and verification](docs/memory-application.md) records dispositions and host-observed regression evidence. Check the current native session with `/kioku-memory-application status` or `/kioku-memory-application status --json`.

### Semantic compaction

ObservationPack (`observationPack: { mode: auto }`) preserves large successful native tool results for two model calls, then replaces them with excerpts and an `observation_read` handle. [Semantic compaction](docs/semantic-compaction.md) evaluates TODO completion boundaries and selectively shortens old tool results before native automatic compaction in normal, Enno and Lisp modes. It defaults to `semanticCompaction: { mode: auto, preemptive: true, budgetMs: 5000 }` and requires a ready typed-decision backend and supported native services. Inspect activation and the last outcome with `/kioku-decisions status`. Results whose complete-line excerpt would contain no source text are retained in full instead of being packed. Existing v1 packs and handles remain readable and restorable.

Laya compaction separately defaults to `typedDecisions.laya-coreml.compaction.mode: off`. Explicit `shadow` evaluates without changing history; `auto` remains `experimental_not_qualified`. This switch preserves ObservationPack and native summaries. Akinator uses only the verified debug/research/writing range, and optional Skill selection uses up to four complete candidates with at most one model-selected addition. See [Laya settings and evaluation](docs/semantic-compaction.md#local-laya).

## Optional code intelligence

`kioku.code` uses `@askdkc/dsh-lsp-server` to read code structure and LSP results from Lisp.
Install or update it in the same profile as `kiokuko-dsh`. For CLI, replace `web` with `dsh-cli`.

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add @askdkc/dsh-lsp-server@latest
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web update @askdkc/dsh-lsp-server --latest
```

See [setup, supported languages and limits](docs/code-intelligence.md).

# DSH 凭据保险库（dsh-key-vault）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 用的本地加密凭据插件。对应四条要求：

| 要求 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 跨对话记忆凭据 | 凭据存在磁盘上的加密保险库，重启、换对话、换工作区都还在 |
| 加密存储在本地 | 每个密钥用 AES-256-GCM 单独封装，用户名与备注同样加密；文件里只有密文 |
| 管理 Agent 在当前对话可用的凭据 | 输入框左侧的钥匙按钮打开「本对话可用凭据」，逐条开关；授权只在内存里，应用重启即失效 |
| 查看 Agent 使用的凭据 | 设置页「凭据 > Agent 读取记录」按时间列出每一次读取（凭据名、对话、用途） |

## 文件

```
.
  package.json          bundle 清单（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client）
  cordis.patch.yml      插入一行 id: keymanager
  main.js               宿主半：会话授权、三个工具、POST /keymanager/rpc
  core.js               保险库：AES-256-GCM 封装、原子写盘、审计
  client.js             浏览器半：钥匙药丸 + 浮层面板 + 设置页
  locale/en.json        插件卡片标题与描述（英文）
  locale/zh.json        同上（中文）
  icon.svg              插件图标
  README.md             本文件
  test/
    vault-probe.mjs     保险库加密 / 持久化 / 错误路径
    host-probe.mjs      宿主半：三个工具 + HTTP 端点 + 鉴权门 + 输出 schema 校验
    client-probe.mjs    浏览器半：模块加载、槽位注册、样式与中英文渲染
```

## 安装与卸载

这是一个 DSH **bundle 插件**：宿主侧是一个 Loader 行，浏览器侧由 `dsh.client` 声明，运行时依赖宿主的 `tools`、`webServer`、`connection` 三个服务（缺一个就整体不激活）。

1. 把本目录放到任意位置（例如 `~/plugins/dsh-key-vault`）。
2. 用 plugin manager 把它装进某个 profile，`target` 传**目录路径**：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = <放插件的目录>/dsh-key-vault
```

它会做三件事：在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加一条 `link:` 依赖、把插件加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`、在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里插入 `- id: keymanager`（行配置可写 `dataDir` / `keyEnv`）。

卸载（不动保险库数据）：

```
plugin_manager remove_bundle    target = dsh-key-vault
```

> 本地改代码后**必须重启 DSH**：Node 按模块 URL 缓存 ESM，同一进程内重装同名包不会加载新代码（开发期可换一个新包名重装来立即生效）。浏览器半改完只需刷新页面。

## 客户端通道

浏览器半调用宿主半只有一条路：`POST /keymanager/rpc`，请求体 `{ method, args }`，应答 `{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`。

这条路由是宿主 `webServer` 上的一个 **exact 路由**，处理函数第一件事是 `ctx.connection.admit({ headers })`：Host/Origin 围栏与浏览器会话 cookie 都由宿主 connection 服务判定，插件不自建鉴权。被拒时按 401/403 原样返回。

> 早期版本用 `ctx.connection.rpc.handle('/keymanager', …)` 注册前缀通道，实测请求根本匹配不到该通道、落到 SPA 静态兜底并返回 **405**（`dsh-host-frontend-static` 对非 GET/HEAD 一律 405）。改成 exact 路由 + `admit()` 后 `POST /keymanager/rpc` 正常。

排查用日志：`<dataDir>/rpc.log`，只记时间、方法名、结果码与错误文本，**不记参数值、不记密钥**；超过 256 KiB 自动清空。

## 语言

界面文案、工具描述、参数说明、工具返回文本与报错全部为中文；英文只作为回退：

- 浏览器半的词典在 `client.js` 的 `DICT`（`en` / `zh`），**只在本 bundle 内解析**：读 Client locale 服务的 `getSnapshot().active`，并用 `subscribe` 跟随切换；服务缺失时退回 `navigator.language`，最后退回英文。缺失键回退英文，再回退键名。
- 不把词典注册进 locale 服务的共享命名空间。曾被这个问题坑过一次：热更新时旧 bundle 代次仍占着同一个命名空间，新代次的 `register` 抛错被吞掉，于是所有标签退化成原始 key（例如直接显示 `panel.title`）；改为本地取词后不会再受代次影响。
- 宿主半的中文直接写在 `main.js` 与 `core.js`（工具描述、`render` 文本、`VaultError` 消息），因为模型侧文案不走浏览器 locale。
- 资源标识保持不变：工具名仍是 `credential_list / credential_reveal / credential_save`，kind 枚举仍是 `login / token / api-key / ssh / note`，只在展示层翻译。

界面文案刷新页面即可生效；**工具描述与报错属于宿主模块，改动后需重启 DSH Desktop 才生效**（Node 按模块 URL 缓存 ESM，原因见「已知限制」）。

## 使用

### 1. 存入凭据

「设置 > 凭据」底部表单：名称（Agent 以后用它称呼这条凭据，例如 `example.com`）、类型、用户名、密钥、备注、标签。列表里可编辑；删除需要二次确认。

也可以直接让 Agent 记：`credential_save` 不需要任何授权（它不读旧值），覆盖同名条目必须显式 `overwrite=true`。存完的那条会**自动对当前对话开放**，因为内容本来就在这段对话里出现过。

### 2. 让本对话可用

两种方式，效果相同：

**你自己开**：对话输入框左侧的工具行有一个钥匙按钮，显示 `已开放/总数`。点开：

- 每条凭据一个开关。打开后 Agent 才能在本对话里读到它的密钥；
- `- 自动` 表示该条「所有对话都可读取」；
- 面板底部列出本对话最近 5 次读取。

**Agent 申请、你批准**：Agent 调 `credential_reveal` 读取一条尚未开放的凭据时，对话里会弹出确认卡片「允许本对话读取凭据「x」吗？」并附上 Agent 说明的用途。

- 选**允许本对话使用** → 立即开放该条并把密钥返回给 Agent；这条授权在本对话内继续有效，后续读取不再重复询问；
- 选**拒绝** → Agent 收到 `ACCESS_DENIED`，拿不到密钥；
- 120 秒内无人作答 → Agent 收到 `ACCESS_TIMEOUT`，并提示你去钥匙面板手动打开；
- 宿主没有 `userQuestions` 服务（例如某些纯 CLI 组合）→ 直接回落到「请用户去开开关」的提示。

授权是**每个对话**的，只存在宿主内存里：应用重启、插件重载都会清空。新对话默认看不到任何凭据——这是刻意的默认值。Agent 的申请只负责发起，批准永远是用户自己的动作。

### 3. Agent 侧工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `credential_list` | 列出**全部**凭据的元数据（名称/类型/用户名/备注/标签/使用次数）与「本对话是否可读」，**永不返回密钥** |
| `credential_reveal` | 读取某条凭据的密钥；未开放时向用户弹出授权申请，用户同意才返回；每次读取都写入审计 |
| `credential_save` | 新建/覆盖凭据；不读回旧值 |

`credential_reveal` 返回的密钥会进入当前对话的会话记录（这是把密钥交给模型的代价）。工具描述要求 Agent 直接把它用掉、不要在回复里复述。

## 安全模型

### 加密

- AES-256-GCM，每条目独立 12 字节 IV，AAD 绑定条目 id（密文不能在条目之间调换）。
- 主密钥 32 字节随机数。两种来源：环境变量（`keyEnv`，默认 `DSH_KEYMANAGER_KEY`，值为 64 位十六进制或 32 字节 base64），或保险库旁的 `vault.key`（`0600` 尽力而为）。
- 写盘走「临时文件 + rename」原子替换，`vault.json` 只含密文、IV、认证标签与非敏感元数据（名称、类型、标签、时间、使用次数、审计）。

### 数据位置

默认 `<DSH_HOME>/keymanager/`（Windows 上就是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\keymanager\`）。行配置可改：

```yaml
- id: keymanager
  config:
    dataDir: 'D:\somewhere\keymanager'
    keyEnv: 'DSH_KEYMANAGER_KEY'
    keyFile: never          # 可选：env-only，禁止把主密钥写到磁盘
```

### 边界（如实理解，这决定了它适合什么场景）

**真实边界是「同一 Windows 用户」，不是「同一对话」。** 授权面板与钥匙开关在威胁模型里只约束「模型老实走工具」，对同用户进程无效：

- 主密钥与密文默认同目录、同 ACL。任何以你的身份运行的进程（首当其冲是 Agent 自己的 shell 工具）读走这两个文件即可离线解密全部凭据，授权表对它完全不起作用。
- 想真正隔离，把主密钥放进系统密钥库（Windows Credential Manager / DPAPI 保护的文件均可），用启动环境注入，并设 `keyFile: never`——此时插件拒绝在磁盘上生成主密钥，没有环境变量就直接报 `NO_KEY`，宁可不工作也不降级。
- 工具输出不回传任何文件路径（只剩算法名）；路径只在设置页给你看。
- `credential_reveal` 的卡片文本改为掩码，但**完整密钥仍在工具结果里**，并随会话记录、记忆日志（明文 JSONL）落盘，事后不可撤回——这是「把密钥交给模型」的固有代价，不是插件能消除的。
- 覆盖同一条目要用户二次确认（`autoGrant` 已从工具参数移除，只有设置页能开「所有对话可读」）。
- 授权对话框里，用途文本先清洗控制字符与双向覆盖字符、截到 120 字，并以凭据自身备注为主、模型自述为辅。
- 同一对话对同一凭据的申请有 60 秒退避；同源页面写授权的频率也有限制，每一次授权写入都记进 `rpc.log`（权限 `0600` 尽力而为）。
- 「同源即操作员」是宿主自己的边界：任何同源客户端脚本都能替会话写授权，这是平台性质，插件只做限流与留痕。
- Windows 下 POSIX 权限位无效，`0600` 是尽力而为；实际保护来自用户目录 ACL。
- 授权是「对话级」而非「每次调用」，且在应用重启前不过期。
- 明文元数据与审计：`vault.json` 里的名称、类型、标签、时间、`purpose`、会话 id 未加密——没有主密钥也能读出「有哪些凭据、什么时候被用过、做了什么」，这是我们选择的可审计性，不是加密承诺的一部分。
- 审计与密文同文件，属于防篡改（改文件会破坏 GCM 校验），不是防删除。
- 子 Agent（被父会话拥有的 child）是独立会话 id，读不到父会话的授权；这是 fail-closed，不是漏洞。
- 宿主半把 `webServer` 与 `connection` 声明为硬依赖：没有它们的 profile（例如纯 CLI）里整个插件不激活，工具也不会出现。

### 审查结论与处置（2026-10-17）

| 级别 | 问题 | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 高 | 主密钥与密文同目录、同用户可读 | 未改默认（兼容已有库），新增 `keyFile: never` 与文档边界；推荐 env + 系统密钥库 |
| 高 | `credential_list` 把主密钥路径交给模型 | 已修：工具输出只留算法名，`render` 去掉路径行 |
| 中高 | `reveal` 明文被持久化到会话/记忆日志 | 已缓解：卡片文本掩码；完整值仍随工具结果落盘（文档写明） |
| 中高 | `autoGrant` / `overwrite` 由模型自选 | 已修：`autoGrant` 移出工具参数；`overwrite` 走二次确认 |
| 中 | 授权对话框内容与长度由模型控制 | 已修：控制字符与 bidi 清洗、120 字上限、备注优先 |
| 中 | 同源脚本可无手势写授权；同意无频率限制 | 已缓解：60 秒退避、授权写入限流、审计留痕（同源=操作员属平台边界） |
| 低 | 明文元数据/审计、`rpc.log` 权限、错误回显名册 | 已修：`rpc.log` 用 `0600` 创建；`locate` 不再枚举名称；明文元数据已在文档写明 |
| 低 | 审计写入绕开队列 | 已修：`reveal()` 走 `#mutate` 队列，并发读不再丢审计行（`concurrent-audit` 断言） |
| 低 | 授权无过期、密钥不 zeroize、子 Agent 无授权 | 保留并在上文写明（子 Agent 无授权是 fail-closed 行为） |

### 密钥丢失 / 更换

`vault.key` 丢失后条目无法解密：列表里标记 `locked`，读取返回 `DECRYPT_FAILED`。把原 `vault.key` 放回即可恢复；没有备份只能删库重录。更换主密钥目前需要备份 `vault.json` 后删库重建。

## 验收记录

在本机（DSH Desktop，Harness 0.2.0-rc.2，profile `desktop`）完成：

1. **保险库**（`test/vault-probe.mjs`）：创建/列表/读取/轮换/同进程重开/删除全部通过；磁盘文件不含明文密钥、用户名、备注；用另一把主密钥读取返回 `DECRYPT_FAILED`；同名（大小写不敏感）返回 `NAME_TAKEN`。
2. **宿主半**（`test/host-probe.mjs`）：三个工具注册成功，每个工具返回值都按自身 `output.schema` 校验通过；保存后本对话可读、另一对话不可读；RPC 的 `list / grant / create / update / remove / usage` 全部 `ok:true`；未知方法、未知凭据名给出明确错误；审计计数正确。
3. **实机工具链**（真实宿主 + 独立子会话）：`credential_list → credential_save → credential_list → credential_reveal` 全链路成功，密钥精确匹配；另一个独立会话调用 `credential_reveal` 被拒绝（`is not enabled for this conversation`）。
4. **客户端通道**：`rpc.log` 记录到 `apply` → `route /keymanager/rpc` → `ok list`，即页面里的钥匙按钮确实通过新路由取到了数据；实时槽位里 `conversation.input.left#keymanager-pill` 与 `settings.section#keymanager` 均为 active。
5. **浏览器半**（`test/client-probe.mjs`）：模块加载、三个槽位注册、空状态渲染不抛错；`PROBE_LOCALE=zh-CN` 与 `en` 两种语言下分别断言设置页与打开后的面板显示对应语言、且不含原始 key（`i18n-settings`、`panel-open` 的 `i18n` / `no-raw-keys` 全为 true）。
6. **汉化**：宿主探针断言工具描述、参数说明与 `render` 文本为中文（`description-zh`、`render-zh-empty`、`render-zh-save` 全为 true），报错同样为中文（`未对本对话开放`、`找不到名为…`）；界面侧 `locked` 徽标、网络与协议错误也走中文词典。`locale-probe.mjs` 静态核对在用的 63 个文案键在 en / zh 两份词典（各 67 键）中均存在且键集一致。
7. **对话内授权**（`test/host-probe.mjs`，伪 `userQuestions`）：拒绝 → `ACCESS_DENIED`（确认卡片的问题文本含凭据名、超时值大于 0）；批准 → 返回正确密钥，且同一对话第二次读取不再弹窗（`asked` 计数不变）；无人作答 → `ACCESS_TIMEOUT`；无该服务 → 回落 `NOT_AVAILABLE`。
8. **安装**：`install_bundle` 返回 `application: applied`、无 warning。
9. **安全加固**（`test/host-probe.mjs`、`test/vault-probe.mjs`）：`reveal-masked`（卡片不含明文、含「已掩码」）、`list-hides-paths`（输出无 `keyPath` / `vaultPath`，只剩 `algorithm`）、`save-no-autogrant`（工具参数已无 `autoGrant`）、`overwrite-denied` / `overwrite-confirmed` / `overwrite-applied`（拒绝则原值不变、同意才替换）、`approval-cooldown`（60 秒内重复申请不再弹窗）、`grant-rate-limit`（第 31 次授权写入返回 `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`）、`sanitize-name` / `purpose-clamped`（bidi 与控制字符被剥离、用途截到 120 字）、`no-key-file`（`keyFile: never` + 无环境变量 → `NO_KEY` 且不写 `vault.key`）、`unknown-name`（错误不再枚举名称）、`concurrent-audit`（5 个并发读取的审计行一条不丢）。

## 已知限制

- 授权表在宿主内存里，插件重载 / 应用重启清空（保险库不受影响）。
- 没有「每次读取都弹确认」模式：一次批准在本对话内持续有效，直到重启或你在面板里关掉。需要逐次确认的凭据只能靠不打开开关。
- 子 Agent（被父会话拥有的 child）没有人工应答者，它的读取申请会回落成「请用户去开开关」，不会弹卡片；需要授权时请在主对话里操作。
- 审计最多保留最近 500 条。
- 只有「读密钥」一种消费方式；把密钥注入子进程环境而不让模型看到（`credential_exec`）是后续可加的能力。
- **升级插件后要重启应用**：Node 按模块 URL 缓存 ESM，同一进程内重装同名包不会加载新代码。改完代码请重启 DSH Desktop；开发期用新包名重装可以立刻生效（本插件就是这样迭代的）。

## 许可证

MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。本插件为原创实现、无第三方依赖；DSH 宿主与装载器同样以 MIT 发布，本插件不改变其许可。
