evidence.readmeExcerpt: # doubao-image — generate images with the local Doubao app > 面向：使用者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20 Registers one tool, `generate_image`, that drives the **locally installed and logged-in Doubao (豆包) desktop app** to produce a picture, saves the full-resolution file, and sends it into the conversation. ``` plugins/doubao-image/ ├── package.json # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch, exports ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle patch: the loader row ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # cordis plugin: the generate_image tool │ ├── doubao.mjs # app launch, prompt submission, result harvest │ ├── cdp.mjs # dependency-free Chrome DevTools Protocol client │ ├── watermark.mjs # removes Doubao's own overlay, with a self-check │ ├── image.mjs # minimal PNG codec + raster helpers │ └── generate.mjs # CLI driver, for testing without spending a model turn └── test/ # node --test (no DSH, no app, no network) ``` ## Install ```bash # from npm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-doubao-image # or from the repository root — the leading ./ matters: DSH anchors relative specs # against your current directory, otherwise pnpm would resolve it inside the profile dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/doubao-image ``` Then restart DSH (or reload the profile). The tool appears as `generate_image`. ## Use ```bash # exercise the whole path without going through the model node plugins/doubao-image/lib/generate.mjs \ --prompt "一只戴黄铜护目镜的橘猫，坐在双翼飞机驾驶舱里" \ --style "黏土质感 C4D 渲染，暖色夕阳光" \ --out ~/Pictures/doubao ``` The tool takes `prompt` (required) plus `style`, `composition`, `aspect`, `negative`, `count`, `dir`, and `reuseCurrentChat`. ## How it works, and why it is built this way Doubao ships a **full Chromium** (`Contents/Helpers/Doubao Browser.app`), and its launcher forwards unknown flags, so starting it with `--remote-debugging-port` yields a real CDP endpoint. That is the whole reason this works without the macOS Accessibility permission that `osascript` would need — which matters, because that permission is not granted on this machine. The findings each step depends on, all established by probing the running app: | Step | What is actually true | | --- | --- | | Launch | Doubao holds a **singleton lock**. A normally-launched instance never opens the debug port, and launching again just forwards to it. The app must therefore be quit and restarted — the first call costs ~10–40 s. | | Attach | `doubao-chat` is the real 1200×800 window. `doubao-launcher` is a 400×600 **sidebar that also accepts prompts** and renders results at 90 px, and `doubao-chat` is *additionally* served as an empty `hello` shell. Identification uses live window size plus the presence of the editor, never the URL alone. | | Type | The box is `div.tiptap.ProseMirror[contenteditable=true]`. `execCommand('insertText')` goes through the same `beforeinput` path a keystroke does, so the app's own state and send button update. Assigning `innerText` would not. | | Detect | The status sentence 「已生成 N 张候选图」 is the completion signal, not the image count — the grid mounts placeholders before the renders arrive. | | Harvest | The picture in the grid is a `cpreview_wm1` render behind an overlay, and its full-size sibling `` is a bare `data:image/svg+xml` **placeholder with no pixels**, so the bytes cannot be read from the grid. Instead the tool clicks each thumbnail to open the image viewer and uses the app's own `[data-testid=edit_image_download_button]`, which writes the file to `~/Downloads`; the tool then moves it to `dir`. | `dsh-doctor`-style checks live in the unit tests: the output schema must stay in sync with `execute`, because a tool that returns a value without a declared schema is refused at registration and takes the **whole plugin tree — and every DSH boot, the desktop app included — down with it**. ## The watermark Doubao stamps 「豆包AI生成」 into the bottom-right of every saved picture. It is an overlay the app composites on, not part of the artwork, which is what makes removal a solved problem instead of an inpainting guess. All of this was measured, not assumed: | Property | Measurement | | --- | --- | | Position | Anchored to the bottom-right corner; a glyph mask from one image correlates with an unrelated image's corner at **NCC 0.949** (inverse control −0.949, exactly symmetric) | | Scale | Proportional to the image's **short side**, not its width: 2048²→321×69 box, 1365×2048→214×46 box, both giving width/short ≈ 0.1567. Verified on a second sample per shape | | Blend | Plain alpha composite `C = a·W + (1−a)·B`, fitted at **a = 0.638**, W = 234.4, RMS residual 6.3/255 | | Soft edge | Glyph interiors measure a = 0.63 while the antialiased rim ramps to 0 — which is why a hard 0/1 mask left a visible outline | Removal inverts the composite per pixel, and estimates the artwork behind the mark by coarse-grid interpolation that excludes masked pixels. The output PNG is encoded losslessly (round-trip delta verified 0). **Self-check.** The `verifyOnFlat` helper turns "does it look clean?" into a number: on a flat-background sample the artwork behind the mark is a constant, so any residual offset inside the glyph area *is* the watermark that survived. Measured on a flat 2048² sample: **residual 46.3 → 0.0 (100% removed)**. On a photograph the same metric would be meaningless, so it detects a non-flat frame (background IQR > 8) and says so instead of printing a flattering zero. **Scope.** This targets this one overlay, at this one anchor, with this one calibrated blend. It is not a general watermark remover. It exists for internal reference material — animation reference, storyboards, internal review. Doubao's official API (Volcengine Ark) returns images with no watermark at all, and that is the right channel for anything published or commercial. **Stripping is off by default** (owner's decision, 2026-09-25): an image comes back with Doubao's own 「豆包AI生成」 badge unless the caller explicitly asks for `stripWatermark: true`. Keeping the badge is the safe default — it is what makes a picture traceable to the tool that made it — and the capability stays here for the internal-reference case described above. ## Known limitations - **Generation consumes the user's Doubao quota** (the app reports 「本次生成将 消耗每日免费额度」). Exactly one generation is issued per call; if the plugin cannot confirm a submission it stops rather than retrying, because a blind retry is what once produced duplicate generations. - **The app window is closed and reopened** on the first call, and Doubao must stay running-and-instrumented for the harvest to complete. - The harvest depends on Doubao's own UI markup (`image-box-grid`, `edit_image_download_button`). A Doubao redesign breaks it; the selector surface is deliberately kept to those two names. - The watermark pass only re-encodes PNG. Other formats are saved exactly as downloaded rather than silently recompressed. # DSH Mobile **中文** · [English](README.en.md) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![listed in awesome-deepseek-harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/listed%20in-awesome--deepseek--harness-4D6BFE?logo=awesomelists&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness) [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness) [![iOS 17+](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-17%2B-000000?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](docs/VERSIONING.md) [![TestFlight](https://img.shields.io/badge/TestFlight-join-0D96F6?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk) [![connector on npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-mobile-link?label=connector)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-mobile-link) [![CI](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) 把电脑上的 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 会话接到 iPhone 上：原生 iOS 客户端、电脑侧连接器、可自建的公网中转。手机与电脑连接同一个 DSH host，看到同一批会话与同一条 消息流；电脑上运行中的任务在锁屏后继续执行，电脑上挂起的提问可在手机上直接回答。 电脑不需要公网 IP，也不需要 VPN。 ![每一步工具调用都摊开 · 不用公网 IP 扫码就连上 · 浏览预览一键下载 · 让它把电脑上的文件发回手机](docs/artifacts/demo/appstore/overview.jpg) > 配图为 App Store 宣传图（8 张中的 4 张，横版拼合），内容出自同一套合成会话：输出是真实 agent > 输出，项目为虚构，`relay.example.com` 是占位符。分张素材与生成方式见 [`docs/artifacts/demo/`](docs/artifacts/demo)。 ## 状态与兼容性 | 组件 | 当前版本 | 分发方式 | |---|---|---| | iOS App | 1.0 | TestFlight 公开测试（[加入](https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk)）；需先安装 TestFlight，构建 90 天后过期 | | 连接器 `dsh-plugin-mobile-link` | 0.6.0 | npm | | 中转（DLP v1） | 本仓库 `relay/` | 自行部署 | 三者的版本组合与发布策略见 [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md)。 表中版本以 **npm 上已发布的为准**（`npm view dsh-plugin-mobile-link version`），不是仓库里 `package.json` 的值。 ## 前提 - 电脑上已安装并可运行 DSH（`dsh web`）。 - 连接器需要 Node.js ≥ 22。 - 自建中转需要一台有公网 IP 的主机（macOS 或 Linux）与 Caddy。 - 从源码构建 App 需要 macOS + Xcode 16 以上；日常使用不需要。 ## 快速开始 ### A. 使用公共中转 1. 手机上安装 App：先装 Apple 的 TestFlight，再用 加入测试。 2. 电脑上安装连接器——**按宿主装**（两种宿主档案独立，装错不会报错，只是连接器不会被加载）： - 命令行 web 版（终端里跑 `dsh web`）：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link` - 官方桌面版（双击图标打开的应用）：用应用内的插件页，或应用自带的 `dsh` 命令装进 `desktop` 档案 （普通 npm 版 `dsh` 会拒绝该档案，这是官方设计）。宿主形态的识别判据（双击图标启动还是敲命令启动）见 [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。 3. 登记到中转：`dsh-mobile-link enroll --invite <邀请码> --relay wss://<中转地址>/dsh-link` 4. 让连接器用上这个身份：重启一次宿主（`dsh web`），或在启动时就带上邀请码 （`DSH_MOBILE_LINK_INVITE=<邀请码> dsh web`）。**第 2 步装插件本身不需要重启**——命令行 web 宿主会 自己把新装的插件挂上；桌面版按应用内提示。 5. 手机 App →「扫码配对」，扫描电脑上的二维码：点 DSH 界面**左下角的「移动端连接」**，小窗里就是 二维码、配对码与有效期（也可用 `node scripts/dev/show-pair-qr.mjs` 在没有界面的环境里出图）。 邀请码为一次性、绑定一台电脑，在 [issue #1](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/issues/1) 领取； 中转地址与邀请码写在同一行。登录后确认手机顶部显示「已连接」，即为成功。故障排查见 [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。 ### B. 自建中转 ```bash cd relay export DSH_RELAY_SITE=<站点> # 仓库中只有占位符，真值属于部署方 sudo -E ./deploy/deploy.sh # 幂等：建用户、装 systemd 单元、挂 Caddy 路由 python3 admin.py --db state.db account-create --name "<名称>" python3 admin.py --db state.db invite-mint --note "<备注>" --count 1 \ --relay wss://<站点>/dsh-link # 铸出的邀请码回到 A 的第 3 步使用 ``` 实时负载与每设备流量：`curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/stats`（仅监听回环）。限额与运维细节见 [`relay/README.md`](relay/README.md)。 ## 组件与数据流 ``` ┌──────────────┐ WSS ┌────────────────────┐ WSS ┌───────────────────┐ │ iPhone App ├─────────►│ Relay（公网主机） │◄─────────┤ 电脑侧连接器 │ │ SwiftUI │ │ 鉴权 + 转发 │ │ (DSH 插件) │ └──────────────┘ └────────────────────┘ └─────────┬─────────┘ │ HTTP + WS ┌─────────▼─────────┐ │ dsh web │ │ 127.0.0.1: │ └───────────────────┘ ``` | 组件 | 位置 | 职责 | |---|---|---| | iOS App | 手机 | 会话列表、转写、图片与文件、配对与设备管理 | | 连接器 | 电脑（DSH 插件） | 以 `127.0.0.1` 访问本机 DSH，转成中转帧 | | 中转 | 公网主机 | 鉴权与按 `agentId` 转发；**不解析会话内容** | | DSH host | 电脑 | 会话、agent 与工具的真实执行方 | 产品上只提供经中转这一条连接方式（`dsh://direct` 是 DEBUG-only 的测试通道）。选型与边界见 [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 与 [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md)。 ## 配置 仓库中出现的 `relay.example.com` 一律是占位符：中转地址属于部署方，不属于仓库。真值只存在于本机， 且均被 gitignore： | 位置 | 用途 | 提供方式 | |---|---|---| | `.env.local` | 发布脚本、开发探针 | `cp .env.example .env.local`，填 `DSH_SITE` / `DSH_RELAY_URL` / `DSH_OTA_HOST` | | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | 连接器的中转地址与身份 | `dsh-mobile-link enroll --invite <码> --relay <地址>` | | `ios/DSHMobile/Config.local.xcconfig` | App 内预填的中转地址与更新源 | 从 `Config.xcconfig` 复制后填写 | 因此直接 clone 构建出的 App 默认连不上任何中转，这是有意设计。 ## 开发 ```bash cd ios/DSHMobile/DSHKit && swift test # 协议层 cd plugins/mobile-link && npm test # 连接器 cd relay && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q # 中转 npm run check:secrets # 本机真值没有进跟踪文件 npm run check:docs # 文档规范（结构、口吻、链接） cd ios/DSHMobile && xcodebuild -scheme DSHMobile \ -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=DSH-Test' build ``` 上述单测与一次「不带任何本机配置」的 Release 构建由 GitHub Actions 在干净仓库上执行。需要仿真器、 真实中转或开发者团队 ID 的验证不在 CI 内——CI 通过不等于可以发布。 界面测试是一套独立测试台：`./test/run.sh prepare` → `run <用例>` → `report --verdict …`，口径见 [`test/RULES.md`](test/RULES.md)，可复制的用例模板见 [`test/examples/`](test/examples)。 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md) | 两种部署路径的选择、操作步骤、故障排查 | | [`docs/GLOSSARY.md`](docs/GLOSSARY.md) | 术语表（DSH、host、连接器、中转、DLP 等） | | [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | 架构与关键决策 | | [`docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md) | DSH 原生协议参考（权威、面向实现） | | [`docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md) | DLP v1 中转协议规范 | | [`docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md`](docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md) / [`docs/RELAY-NOTES.md`](docs/RELAY-NOTES.md) | 实现与规范的偏差记录 | | [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md) | 连接方式与配对设计 | | [`docs/IMAGES.md`](docs/IMAGES.md) | 图片能力的设计约束与实现 | | [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md) | 三处部署的版本与发布策略 | | [`docs/PRIVACY.md`](docs/PRIVACY.md) | 隐私说明：App 不收集数据，中转只做转发 | | [`docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json`](docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json) | 某次快照：机器可读的 RPC 目录（不是持续校验的契约） | | [`docs/artifacts/samples/`](docs/artifacts/samples) | 从真实 DSH 抓取的响应样例（已脱敏） | 参与开发见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)，安全问题的报告方式见 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md)， 版本变化见 [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 已知限制 - **iOS 安装走 TestFlight**：需先安装 Apple 的 TestFlight；测试构建 90 天后过期，到期需安装新构建。 自行部署时也可以走 OTA（部署脚本会生成 `https://<站点>/ios/`）：那用 Ad Hoc 描述文件， 只覆盖已登记 UDID 的设备，适合自己用，不适合公开分发。 - **后台通知覆盖这些场景**：从手机发出任务后把 App 退到后台，任务完成、以及 Agent 提问后 等待回答（App 列表顶部会显示一条待回应提示）这两件事，仍会通知到手机。它只在 「有任务在跑，或有待回答的提问」时生效，空闲时不耗电。 - **这些场景不覆盖**：手机在后台时，电脑端**新开始**的会话唤不起 App（需要 APNs，尚未实现）； 长时间未回答的提问可能丢失。 - 文件发送仅在经中转时可用。 ## 许可 MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-plugin-mobile-link

[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![listed in awesome-deepseek-harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/listed%20in-awesome--deepseek--harness-4D6BFE?logo=awesomelists&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-mobile-link)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-mobile-link)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](../../LICENSE)

> 面向：使用者与实现者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20

**The computer half of [DSH Mobile](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile): it
dials a relay over WSS, so the native iOS client reaches this DSH instance even
though the computer has no public IP.**

```
iPhone App ──WSS──▶ Relay（公网，只鉴权与转发）──WSS──▶ this plugin ──HTTP+WS──▶ 127.0.0.1:<port>
```

The connector always talks to the local DSH as `127.0.0.1:<port>`, so the host's
authority and its trust fence are unaffected: no `--trusted-host`, no rewritten
`Host`, no new listening port on this machine.

```
plugins/mobile-link/
├── package.json          # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch, bin: dsh-mobile-link
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch: the loader row + config reference
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # cordis plugin: starts the agent, registers 3 routes
│   ├── link.js           # the DLP agent transport: identity, socket, heartbeat, reconnect
│   ├── router.js         # frames ⇄ local DSH mux streams, per-device `$events`
│   ├── dlp.js            # DLP v1 frame codec (shared with the relay)
│   ├── files.js          # phone → computer file transfers (`_link/file*` methods)
│   ├── enroll.js         # invite-code redemption, writes ~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json
│   ├── journal.js        # lifecycle journal: why a relay link was dropped, after the fact
│   ├── routes.js         # GET /mobile-link/status, POST /pair-code, GET /qr
│   ├── qr.js             # dependency-free QR SVG
│   └── cli.js            # dsh-mobile-link: enroll / mint-pair-code
└── test/                 # node --test, 100+ tests (no DSH, no network)
```

## Install

The connector runs in whichever host runs your DSH. There are two supported hosts today —
**the official desktop app** and **the command-line web host** — and each keeps its own
profile, so you install the plugin into the one you actually use. The connector discovers
the local DSH by itself in both (the host hands it the authenticated loopback address);
you never type an address or a token.

**Command-line web host**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link
```

**Official desktop app** — install through the app's own plugin page, or with the CLI that
the app ships (`…/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh`, installable from its settings). The npm
`dsh` refuses this profile on purpose (`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the
Electron application`). Two prerequisites matter in practice: let the app start once so it
initializes its profile, and **quit it completely** before installing — otherwise the
profile is locked.

```bash
# quoting the app's bundled CLI; see docs/ONBOARDING.md for the section titles
"<DeepSeek Harness.app>/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-mobile-link
```

Then restart the host (or reload the profile). From a checkout the same command takes
a path — the leading `./` matters, because DSH anchors a relative spec against
your current directory instead of resolving it inside the profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/mobile-link
```

## Use

1. Register this computer with a relay (once). Either redeem an invite code:

   ```bash
   dsh-mobile-link enroll --invite <邀请码> --relay wss://<你的站点>/dsh-link
   ```

   …or register it on the relay host with `relay/admin.py agent-register
   --write-config ~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json`.

2. Mint a pairing code, and show it as a QR the phone camera can read:

   ```bash
   dsh-mobile-link --mint-pair-code        # prints JSON: code + relay + agentId
   ```

   Or open the **移动端连接** panel at the bottom of the sidebar in the DSH client
   (spec 010) — same code, same QR, with the validity countdown.

3. Scan it in the iOS app. After that the phone reconnects on its own — nothing
   else has to be run by hand.

`GET /mobile-link/status` reports whether the link is up, which devices are
attached, and whether this computer is registered yet. Its `journal` block carries
the current process's newest lifecycle events (link opened/closed with the reason,
device attached/detached); the counters in it reset when the plugin hot-reloads, so
the full history — across restarts — is the JSONL file at `journal.path`.

## Configuration

All optional; the defaults are what a stock deployment needs. Set them in the
plugin's config block (`cordis.patch.yml`), not by editing this file.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` stops the outbound link without uninstalling |
| `relayUrl` | from `agent.json` | Relay base URL; a bare deployment dials `<relay>/link/agent` |
| `agentId` / `agentSecret` | from `agent.json` | Override the enrolled identity |
| `stateFile` | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | Where the identity lives |
| `journalFile` | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/link-events.jsonl` | Lifecycle journal (rotated once at 256 KiB); `false` keeps it in memory only |
| `slowRequestMs` | `2000` | A slower single request gets its own `request.slow` entry; `0` disables those (per-attach `device.summary` is still written) |
| `diagnostics` | `true` | `false` refuses the phone's phase uploads; the phone ignores the refusal and stays connected |
| `dshUrl` | discovery | Explicit local DSH base URL (usually unnecessary — the host hands the connector its own address) |
| `heartbeatMs` | `20000` | DLP ping interval |

The connector does **not** read an endpoint handoff file any more: discovery happens inside
the host process (`ctx.inject(['webServer','connection'])`), which is what makes one npm
package work on both the desktop app and the command-line host. It **writes** one instead —
`$DSH_HOME/mobile-link/endpoint.json`, mode 0600 — for tools that run *outside* the host
(our dev/test scripts and the iOS integration helpers).

Address resolution order: this config block, then `DSH_RELAY_URL` (or
`DSH_MOBILE_LINK_RELAY`), then the enrolled identity file, then the repository
placeholder `wss://relay.example.com/dsh-link` — the placeholder being the
"nothing configured yet" sentinel rather than a real address.

## Design notes

- **No required services.** `inject` is empty and the routes are attached through
  `ctx.inject([...])`, so a future DSH that renames or drops `webServer` /
  `connection` cannot make the tunnel fatal on boot.
- **Protocol-transparent.** Nothing outside `lib/` is imported and no DSH
  business API is touched: the connector forwards frames, it does not interpret
  sessions. The relay has the same property.
- **Disable** by removing the row from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or by
  setting `enabled: false`.

## Test

```bash
cd plugins/mobile-link && npm test    # zero dependencies
```

The wire protocol is specified in
[`docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md`](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/blob/main/docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md).

| 组件 | 当前版本 | 分发方式 |

| 连接器 `dsh-plugin-mobile-link` | 0.6.0 | npm |
| 中转（DLP v1） | 本仓库 `relay/` | 自行部署 |

三者的版本组合与发布策略见 [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md)。
表中版本以 **npm 上已发布的为准**（`npm view dsh-plugin-mobile-link version`），不是仓库里 `package.json` 的值。

## 前提

- 电脑上已安装并可运行 DSH（`dsh web`）。
- 连接器需要 Node.js ≥ 22。
- 自建中转需要一台有公网 IP 的主机（macOS 或 Linux）与 Caddy。
- 从源码构建 App 需要 macOS + Xcode 16 以上；日常使用不需要。

## 快速开始

### A. 使用公共中转

1. 手机上安装 App：先装 Apple 的 TestFlight，再用 <https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk> 加入测试。
2. 电脑上安装连接器——**按宿主装**（两种宿主档案独立，装错不会报错，只是连接器不会被加载）：
   - 命令行 web 版（终端里跑 `dsh web`）：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link`
   - 官方桌面版（双击图标打开的应用）：用应用内的插件页，或应用自带的 `dsh` 命令装进 `desktop` 档案
     （普通 npm 版 `dsh` 会拒绝该档案，这是官方设计）。宿主形态的识别判据（双击图标启动还是敲命令启动）见
     [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。
3. 登记到中转：`dsh-mobile-link enroll --invite <邀请码> --relay wss://<中转地址>/dsh-link`
4. 让连接器用上这个身份：重启一次宿主（`dsh web`），或在启动时就带上邀请码
   （`DSH_MOBILE_LINK_INVITE=<邀请码> dsh web`）。**第 2 步装插件本身不需要重启**——命令行 web 宿主会
   自己把新装的插件挂上；桌面版按应用内提示。
5. 手机 App →「扫码配对」，扫描电脑上的二维码：点 DSH 界面**左下角的「移动端连接」**，小窗里就是
   二维码、配对码与有效期（也可用 `node scripts/dev/show-pair-qr.mjs` 在没有界面的环境里出图）。

邀请码为一次性、绑定一台电脑，在 [issue #1](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/issues/1) 领取；
中转地址与邀请码写在同一行。登录后确认手机顶部显示「已连接」，即为成功。故障排查见
[`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。

### B. 自建中转

```bash
cd relay
export DSH_RELAY_SITE=<站点>                 # 仓库中只有占位符，真值属于部署方
sudo -E ./deploy/deploy.sh                   # 幂等：建用户、装 systemd 单元、挂 Caddy 路由
python3 admin.py --db state.db account-create --name "<名称>"
python3 admin.py --db state.db invite-mint --note "<备注>" --count 1 \
    --relay wss://<站点>/dsh-link            # 铸出的邀请码回到 A 的第 3 步使用
```

## 组件与数据流

```
┌──────────────┐   WSS    ┌────────────────────┐   WSS    ┌───────────────────┐
│  iPhone App  ├─────────►│  Relay（公网主机）  │◄─────────┤ 电脑侧连接器       │
│  SwiftUI     │          │  鉴权 + 转发        │          │ (DSH 插件)        │
└──────────────┘          └────────────────────┘          └─────────┬─────────┘
                                                                     │ HTTP + WS
                                                           ┌─────────▼─────────┐
                                                           │ dsh web           │
                                                           │ 127.0.0.1:<port>  │
                                                           └───────────────────┘
```

| 组件 | 位置 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| iOS App | 手机 | 会话列表、转写、图片与文件、配对与设备管理 |
| 连接器 | 电脑（DSH 插件） | 以 `127.0.0.1` 访问本机 DSH，转成中转帧 |
| 中转 | 公网主机 | 鉴权与按 `agentId` 转发；**不解析会话内容** |
| DSH host | 电脑 | 会话、agent 与工具的真实执行方 |

产品上只提供经中转这一条连接方式（`dsh://direct` 是 DEBUG-only 的测试通道）。选型与边界见
[`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 与 [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md)。

仓库中出现的 `relay.example.com` 一律是占位符：中转地址属于部署方，不属于仓库。真值只存在于本机，
且均被 gitignore：

| 位置 | 用途 | 提供方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `.env.local` | 发布脚本、开发探针 | `cp .env.example .env.local`，填 `DSH_SITE` / `DSH_RELAY_URL` / `DSH_OTA_HOST` |
| `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | 连接器的中转地址与身份 | `dsh-mobile-link enroll --invite <码> --relay <地址>` |
| `ios/DSHMobile/Config.local.xcconfig` | App 内预填的中转地址与更新源 | 从 `Config.xcconfig` 复制后填写 |

因此直接 clone 构建出的 App 默认连不上任何中转，这是有意设计。

```bash
cd ios/DSHMobile/DSHKit && swift test        # 协议层
cd plugins/mobile-link  && npm test          # 连接器
cd relay && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q    # 中转
npm run check:secrets                        # 本机真值没有进跟踪文件
npm run check:docs                           # 文档规范（结构、口吻、链接）

cd ios/DSHMobile && xcodebuild -scheme DSHMobile \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=DSH-Test' build
```

## 已知限制

- **iOS 安装走 TestFlight**：需先安装 Apple 的 TestFlight；测试构建 90 天后过期，到期需安装新构建。
  自行部署时也可以走 OTA（部署脚本会生成 `https://<站点>/ios/`）：那用 Ad Hoc 描述文件，
  只覆盖已登记 UDID 的设备，适合自己用，不适合公开分发。
- **后台通知覆盖这些场景**：从手机发出任务后把 App 退到后台，任务完成、以及 Agent 提问后
  等待回答（App 列表顶部会显示一条待回应提示）这两件事，仍会通知到手机。它只在
  「有任务在跑，或有待回答的提问」时生效，空闲时不耗电。
- **这些场景不覆盖**：手机在后台时，电脑端**新开始**的会话唤不起 App（需要 APNs，尚未实现）；
  长时间未回答的提问可能丢失。
- 文件发送仅在经中转时可用。

## 许可

MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

# dsh-plugin-send-image

> 面向：使用者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20

**Lets the agent put a picture into the conversation.** A screenshot, the
clipboard, or a file — the host normalizes and persists the bytes, every DSH
client renders it inline, and the user can open it full screen.

Why a plugin is needed at all: DSH's model adapters declare **text-only output**,
so the agent cannot emit an image in its answer. The bytes reach the client
through the Host's attachment service (`ctx.attachments.saveImage`, which
normalizes and persists them) and the returned reference rides on this tool's
**result**, as an image content block — so every client draws the picture inside
the agent's own turn.

Submitting it as a prompt instead — which is what this plugin used to do — is
wrong twice over: a prompt is a **user message**, so the picture looked like
something the user had sent, and it **started a turn**, so the agent answered its
own screenshot. `send-image.mjs --via-prompt` keeps that path for a client that
cannot render tool-result images; nothing here uses it.

```
plugins/send-image/
├── package.json          # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch: the loader row
├── lib/index.js          # cordis plugin: registers the send_image tool
└── test/                 # node --test, 19 tests (no DSH, no network)
```

The tool is a thin shell around
[`skills/send-image/send-image.mjs`](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/blob/main/skills/send-image/send-image.mjs),
which owns the capture quirks (`screencapture`, `pngpaste`, the screen-recording
permission message) and prints one JSON descriptor. Standalone it only
*prepares* — the publishing half needs the Host context this plugin has:

```bash
node skills/send-image/send-image.mjs --screenshot        # prints the descriptor
node skills/send-image/send-image.mjs --file ./out/render.png
node skills/send-image/send-image.mjs --clipboard         # needs pngpaste
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-send-image
```

Then restart DSH (or reload the profile). From a checkout a relative spec works
too — the leading `./` matters, because DSH anchors it against your current
directory instead of resolving it inside the profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/send-image
```

## Use

The agent calls `send_image`. Exactly one source per call:

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `file` | Path to an image (absolute, or relative to the working directory) |
| `screenshot` | `true` captures the whole screen — the picture contains everything on it |
| `clipboard` | `true` sends the image on the clipboard (needs `pngpaste`) |
| `caption` | Text shown with the picture |

Passing none or several is a readable tool error rather than a schema failure:
source exclusivity is a runtime rule here, so the model is told what to fix.

### You can also take the screenshot yourself

Inside the DSH window, `⌥⌘S` (or the button at the left of the composer) starts a drag-select; the
selected rectangle is **attached to the current conversation as a draft** — you decide whether to send
it. The shortcut only works while the DSH window has focus (no system-wide hotkey), and it can be
rebound under Settings → Shortcuts. `Esc` cancels without leaving a file, and a missing Screen
Recording grant prints where to enable it and which program to restart.

Both supported hosts (the official desktop app and the command-line web host) run the same client
half, shipped in this package. The plugin is hot-pluggable: enabling or disabling it adds or removes
the shortcut, the composer button and its styles in place — no host restart, no page reload.

## Test

```bash
cd plugins/send-image && npm test    # 14 tests, zero dependencies
```

MIT.

- 自建中转需要一台有公网 IP 的主机（macOS 或 Linux）与 Caddy。
- 从源码构建 App 需要 macOS + Xcode 16 以上；日常使用不需要。

## 快速开始

### A. 使用公共中转

1. 手机上安装 App：先装 Apple 的 TestFlight，再用 <https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk> 加入测试。
2. 电脑上安装连接器——**按宿主装**（两种宿主档案独立，装错不会报错，只是连接器不会被加载）：
   - 命令行 web 版（终端里跑 `dsh web`）：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link`
   - 官方桌面版（双击图标打开的应用）：用应用内的插件页，或应用自带的 `dsh` 命令装进 `desktop` 档案
     （普通 npm 版 `dsh` 会拒绝该档案，这是官方设计）。宿主形态的识别判据（双击图标启动还是敲命令启动）见
     [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。
3. 登记到中转：`dsh-mobile-link enroll --invite <邀请码> --relay wss://<中转地址>/dsh-link`
4. 让连接器用上这个身份：重启一次宿主（`dsh web`），或在启动时就带上邀请码
   （`DSH_MOBILE_LINK_INVITE=<邀请码> dsh web`）。**第 2 步装插件本身不需要重启**——命令行 web 宿主会
   自己把新装的插件挂上；桌面版按应用内提示。
5. 手机 App →「扫码配对」，扫描电脑上的二维码：点 DSH 界面**左下角的「移动端连接」**，小窗里就是
   二维码、配对码与有效期（也可用 `node scripts/dev/show-pair-qr.mjs` 在没有界面的环境里出图）。

邀请码为一次性、绑定一台电脑，在 [issue #1](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/issues/1) 领取；
中转地址与邀请码写在同一行。登录后确认手机顶部显示「已连接」，即为成功。故障排查见
[`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。

### B. 自建中转

```bash
cd relay
export DSH_RELAY_SITE=<站点>                 # 仓库中只有占位符，真值属于部署方
sudo -E ./deploy/deploy.sh                   # 幂等：建用户、装 systemd 单元、挂 Caddy 路由
python3 admin.py --db state.db account-create --name "<名称>"
python3 admin.py --db state.db invite-mint --note "<备注>" --count 1 \
    --relay wss://<站点>/dsh-link            # 铸出的邀请码回到 A 的第 3 步使用
```

实时负载与每设备流量：`curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/stats`（仅监听回环）。限额与运维细节见
[`relay/README.md`](relay/README.md)。

## 组件与数据流

```
┌──────────────┐   WSS    ┌────────────────────┐   WSS    ┌───────────────────┐
│  iPhone App  ├─────────►│  Relay（公网主机）  │◄─────────┤ 电脑侧连接器       │
│  SwiftUI     │          │  鉴权 + 转发        │          │ (DSH 插件)        │
└──────────────┘          └────────────────────┘          └─────────┬─────────┘
                                                                     │ HTTP + WS
                                                           ┌─────────▼─────────┐
                                                           │ dsh web           │
                                                           │ 127.0.0.1:<port>  │
                                                           └───────────────────┘
```

| 组件 | 位置 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| iOS App | 手机 | 会话列表、转写、图片与文件、配对与设备管理 |
| 连接器 | 电脑（DSH 插件） | 以 `127.0.0.1` 访问本机 DSH，转成中转帧 |
| 中转 | 公网主机 | 鉴权与按 `agentId` 转发；**不解析会话内容** |
| DSH host | 电脑 | 会话、agent 与工具的真实执行方 |

产品上只提供经中转这一条连接方式（`dsh://direct` 是 DEBUG-only 的测试通道）。选型与边界见
[`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 与 [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md)。

## 配置

仓库中出现的 `relay.example.com` 一律是占位符：中转地址属于部署方，不属于仓库。真值只存在于本机，
且均被 gitignore：

| 位置 | 用途 | 提供方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `.env.local` | 发布脚本、开发探针 | `cp .env.example .env.local`，填 `DSH_SITE` / `DSH_RELAY_URL` / `DSH_OTA_HOST` |
| `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | 连接器的中转地址与身份 | `dsh-mobile-link enroll --invite <码> --relay <地址>` |
| `ios/DSHMobile/Config.local.xcconfig` | App 内预填的中转地址与更新源 | 从 `Config.xcconfig` 复制后填写 |

因此直接 clone 构建出的 App 默认连不上任何中转，这是有意设计。

## 开发

```bash
cd ios/DSHMobile/DSHKit && swift test        # 协议层
cd plugins/mobile-link  && npm test          # 连接器
cd relay && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q    # 中转
npm run check:secrets                        # 本机真值没有进跟踪文件
npm run check:docs                           # 文档规范（结构、口吻、链接）

cd ios/DSHMobile && xcodebuild -scheme DSHMobile \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=DSH-Test' build
```

上述单测与一次「不带任何本机配置」的 Release 构建由 GitHub Actions 在干净仓库上执行。需要仿真器、
真实中转或开发者团队 ID 的验证不在 CI 内——CI 通过不等于可以发布。

界面测试是一套独立测试台：`./test/run.sh prepare` → `run <用例>` → `report --verdict …`，口径见
[`test/RULES.md`](test/RULES.md)，可复制的用例模板见 [`test/examples/`](test/examples)。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md) | 两种部署路径的选择、操作步骤、故障排查 |
| [`docs/GLOSSARY.md`](docs/GLOSSARY.md) | 术语表（DSH、host、连接器、中转、DLP 等） |
| [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | 架构与关键决策 |
| [`docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md) | DSH 原生协议参考（权威、面向实现） |
| [`docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md) | DLP v1 中转协议规范 |
| [`docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md`](docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md) / [`docs/RELAY-NOTES.md`](docs/RELAY-NOTES.md) | 实现与规范的偏差记录 |
| [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md) | 连接方式与配对设计 |
| [`docs/IMAGES.md`](docs/IMAGES.md) | 图片能力的设计约束与实现 |
| [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md) | 三处部署的版本与发布策略 |
| [`docs/PRIVACY.md`](docs/PRIVACY.md) | 隐私说明：App 不收集数据，中转只做转发 |
| [`docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json`](docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json) | 某次快照：机器可读的 RPC 目录（不是持续校验的契约） |
| [`docs/artifacts/samples/`](docs/artifacts/samples) | 从真实 DSH 抓取的响应样例（已脱敏） |

参与开发见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)，安全问题的报告方式见 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md)，
版本变化见 [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 已知限制

- **iOS 安装走 TestFlight**：需先安装 Apple 的 TestFlight；测试构建 90 天后过期，到期需安装新构建。
  自行部署时也可以走 OTA（部署脚本会生成 `https://<站点>/ios/`）：那用 Ad Hoc 描述文件，
  只覆盖已登记 UDID 的设备，适合自己用，不适合公开分发。
- **后台通知覆盖这些场景**：从手机发出任务后把 App 退到后台，任务完成、以及 Agent 提问后
  等待回答（App 列表顶部会显示一条待回应提示）这两件事，仍会通知到手机。它只在
  「有任务在跑，或有待回答的提问」时生效，空闲时不耗电。
- **这些场景不覆盖**：手机在后台时，电脑端**新开始**的会话唤不起 App（需要 APNs，尚未实现）；
  长时间未回答的提问可能丢失。
- 文件发送仅在经中转时可用。

## 许可

MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-ux

[![Listed on DSH Directory](https://dsh.directory/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh.directory/plugins/jiangnanquan/dsh-ux)

**中文** | [English](README_EN.md)

DeepSeek Harness(DSH)Web 界面增强插件,由**江南泉**个人开发并免费开源。它在设置面板里提供独立一页「界面增强」,所有开关即时生效;包含 25 套终端美学配色、文字墨色、中文优先字体、紧凑布局、折叠胶囊,以及账户余额 / 用量与官方峰谷提醒。

![dsh-enhance](screenshot.png)

## 能力

| 类别 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| 设置页 | 设置面板左侧独立一页「界面增强」:每项功能即时生效,改完不用重启 |
| 配色主题 | 25 套,取自江南泉《终端美学》三部曲:经典 CRT、纸面浅色、现代双生、AI 品牌;深色主题自动带 `color-scheme: dark` |
| 文字墨色 | 深墨(默认, 推荐)/ 跟随配色 / 纯黑;只改文字 token,浅色主题生效 |
| 字体 | 中文优先的 0.5 窄体等宽方案(更纱黑体 Mono/Term、Noto Mono CJK、Maple Mono…);字重默认半粗(推荐) |
| 布局 | 加宽消息列、收紧对话间距、对齐新对话输入卡片与 / @ 候选菜单、禁用橡皮筋滚动 |
| 折叠胶囊 | 0.1.x:思考块聚合为 `Think ×N`、工具调用聚合为 `A → B → C` 链路胶囊。0.2.0:官方过程分组接管显隐,插件把胶囊摘要挂到「已完成,用时 X」行下方,点击联动官方展开/收起;长链路按可用宽度换行 |
| 账户用量 | 输入框下方显示官方账户余额、本轮 token 成本与近 30 天用量图表;官方 API/账号时附「峰 / 谷」计费徽标 |

长工具链会跟随消息列宽度自动重新分行,每个视觉行保持独立、完整的胶囊轮廓:

![工具链换行后每行独立胶囊](docs/images/tool-chain-multiline-capsules.png)

设置页顶部还有一枚 GitHub Star 入口:如果 dsh-ux 帮到了你,欢迎去仓库点个 Star。

## 配色主题:江南泉《终端美学》三部曲 25 套

设置页「外观 → 配色主题」用一个下拉切换,按来源分组——全部取自江南泉的《终端美学》三部曲。
命名统一为 **English · 中文**:英文保留官方原名与变体名(`Rosé` 的重音也保留),中文只做简短意译,
长名字在下拉里也不会断行。

| 分组 | 主题 |
|------|------|
| 官方 | Official · 官方配色 |
| 经典 CRT(第一部) | P1 Green Phosphor · 绿磷光、P3 Amber Phosphor · 琥珀光、Matrix Rain · 代码雨、Cyberpunk 2077 · 夜之城、Radar Red · 雷达血红、Weyland Corp · 维兰重工、NERV MAGI · 三贤者 |
| 纸面浅色(第二部) | P4 White · 纸白、Everforest Light · 绿色森林、Parchment Classic · 羊皮纸、Solarized Light · 暖羊皮纸、Catppuccin Latte · 拿铁 |
| 现代(第三部) | Tokyo Night · 东京夜、Tokyo Night Day · 东京白昼、Kanagawa Wave · 神奈川·浪、Kanagawa Lotus · 神奈川·莲、Rosé Pine · 玫瑰松木、Rosé Pine Dawn · 玫瑰晨光、Catppuccin Mocha · 摩卡 |
| AI 品牌(第三部) | Claude Light · 书斋浅、Claude Dark · 书斋深、OpenAI Light · 涌现浅、OpenAI Dark · 涌现深、Gemini Light · 极光浅、Gemini Dark · 极光深 |

每套主题只声明**底色、正文、强调、状态色**四个锚点,其余 surface / border / hover / 反白字
由同一套推导规则生成,所以 25 套的层级关系一致,加新配色只需补一行数据。深色主题会自动
设置 `color-scheme: dark`,并使用配色自带的墨色;「文字墨色」只对浅色主题生效。

所有非 Solarized 主题的正文在 `bg` 与 `layer-1` 上都过 WCAG AA(4.5:1);Solarized 保留
原手写 token 的观感,由墨色档位兜底。东京白昼的正文在原始 `#3760BF` 上对 layer-1 只有
4.08:1,已压深 4% 到 `#2F55B5`(4.74:1)。

## 文字墨色:深墨(默认)/ 跟随配色 / 纯黑

Solarized 的默认正文色是 base01 `#586e75`(青灰),在暖黄底上会显得「蒙了一层灰」:
基础面 `#fdf6e3` 上 4.99:1,落到 layer-1 `#eee8d5` 只剩 4.39:1(低于 WCAG AA 的 4.5)。
这一项只改文字 token,不动背景与品牌色,三档:

| 档位 | 效果 |
|------|------|
| 深墨(默认, 推荐) | 暖青黑 `#002b36`,比浅色主题的默认墨色深一档;Solarized 上对 layer-1 从 4.39:1 提到 12.2:1 |
| 跟随配色 | 继承配色自己的墨色(Solarized 即上面的青灰),最贴近原设计 |
| 纯黑 | `#000000`,19.5:1,强光/低视力更清楚,但大段正文会偏硬 |

只作用于浅色:深色配色各自定义 ink,不在这里强行覆盖;按钮主色上的反白字
(`--dsw-alias-label-primary-foreground`)也不受影响。

## 字体:中文优先 / 0.5 窄体西文

依据《终端排版哲学:中文优先与 0.5 窄体等宽工程实战》(本机实测数据见下表):

**汉字是不可妥协的 1.0 正方**。要让「2 个西文字符 = 1 个汉字」严格成立,西文就必须收窄到 **0.5**;
而以西文为基准的编程字体(Menlo、JetBrains Mono、Fira Code、Maple Mono……)西文宽 0.6~0.67,
汉字容器会被撑到 1.2 —— 汉字要么被横向拉宽 20%(矮胖、字怀塌陷),要么两边留白(中文词句涣散)。

本机 CoreText 实测(unitsPerEm=1000,字形前沿宽度):

| 字族 | 西文 `a` | 汉字 `中` | 比值 | `—` | `→` | `★` |
|------|---------|----------|------|-----|-----|-----|
| **Sarasa Mono SC** | 0.500 | 1.000 | **2.000** | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| **Sarasa Term SC** | 0.500 | 1.000 | **2.000** | 0.500 | 0.500 | 0.500 |
| Noto Sans Mono CJK SC | 0.500 | 1.000 | **2.000** | 0.894 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| Sarasa Gothic / UI SC | 0.562 | 1.000 | 1.78 | 1.000 | 0.954 | 1.045 |
| Maple Mono NF CN | 0.600 | **1.200** | 2.000 | 0.600 | 0.600 | — |
| Maple Mono(非 CN) | 0.600 | 无字形 | — | 0.600 | 0.600 | — |

更纱黑体的架构正是这一哲学的产物:西文用 Iosevka(严格 0.5),汉字用思源黑体(1.0),
基线、x 高度、字重曲线都被逐像素对齐过。**Mono 与 Term 的唯一差别是东亚歧义字符**
(—……→★■●):Mono 保持全角(适合读 Markdown、中文标点),Term 压成半角(适合密集网格、
跳格最稳)。Maple Mono NF CN 的汉字被拉到 1.2,正是文章里要避开的那一类。

设置页里可选:

| 方案 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 自动(推荐) | 按可用性依次尝试:更纱黑体 Mono → Term → Noto Mono CJK → Maple Mono;一款都没装就落回官方字体栈 |
| Sarasa Mono SC | 0.5 窄体 + 全角歧义字符 |
| Sarasa Term SC | 0.5 窄体 + 半角歧义字符 |
| Noto Mono CJK | Noto Sans Mono CJK SC,同为 0.5/1.0 |
| Maple Mono | 旧观感(西文 0.6 / 汉字 1.2),保留兼容 |
| 关闭 | 完全不动官方字体栈 |

本机装了哪几款会实时探测并标在页面上(未装的方案置灰,装了字体回来即可,无需重启)。
**字重**另有「标准 / 半粗」两档,默认落在**半粗(推荐)**——把正文抬到 600、强调抬到 700,
用字族自带的矢量 SemiBold(文章 §3.2 的甜点位);两种模式都同时关掉 `font-synthesis`,
即文章 §3.1 的「不用算法级伪粗」——伪粗是光栅化阶段向外描边,会挤占字怀、让笔画黏连。

页面底部还带一块**对齐自检块**(文章 §5 的校验文本,已按 2:1 校齐列宽):
第 1 行 40 个半角字符必须与第 2 行 20 个汉字等宽,方框必须是矩形,一眼就能看出方案对不对。

选型依据、实测数据、加新字族的步骤见 [docs/字体方案-中文优先与0.5窄体.md](docs/字体方案-中文优先与0.5窄体.md)。

## 峰谷提醒(官方 API / 官方账号)

输入框下方那行「本轮 ¥x」后面会多一枚「峰 / 谷」徽标,只在**最近一次请求真实使用的
provider** 是 `deepseek-official` 或 `deepseek-account` 时出现:

| 状态 | 时段(北京时间) | 显示 |
|------|---------------|------|
| 峰 | 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 | 琥珀色「峰」,提示按峰时价计费 |
| 谷 | 其余时段 | 绿色「谷」,提示空闲半价 |

悬停徽标看倒计时(距下一次切换还有多久);「发送」与「选择模型」两个按钮的 `title`
也会同步带上「官方 API 峰时计费 / 空闲半价」,鼠标悬停即可确认。状态每 30 秒重算,
跨过 12:00 / 18:00 不用等下一次用量轮询。

判据是会话日志里的 `request/header.config.provider`,不是「余额能查」——余额走
API Key,用户完全可能刚切到 scnet / opencode2dsh,这时不显示峰谷,避免给出错误的计价提示。

## 设置(即时开关)

打开 **设置 → 界面增强**,这一页就是本插件的全部开关:

| 开关 | 关掉之后 |
|------|----------|
| 启用 dsh-ux 界面增强 | 总开关。整层增强立刻撤下、回到官方外观;各分项的选择保留,再打开时按原样回来 |
| 字体方案 / 字重 | 回官方字体栈与官方字重;方案选「关闭」等价于只关字体层;默认半粗(推荐) |
| 文字墨色 | 三档单选:**深墨**(默认, 推荐)、**跟随配色**、**纯黑**;只影响浅色文字,不动背景与品牌色 |
| 配色主题 | 下拉里选「Official · 官方配色」即回到官方主题;默认 Solarized;25 套主题与命名见上节 |
| 紧凑布局微调 | 消息列宽、间距、输入卡片对齐都回官方几何 |
| 折叠胶囊 | 思考/工具调用恢复成官方逐条展开的样子,注入的胶囊节点同时被收回 |
| 账户余额与用量 | 输入框下方那行余额、本轮成本、峰谷徽标与图表消失,也不再轮询余额接口 |

**全部即时生效,不需要重启**:开关写在 `<html>` 的 `data-dsh-ux-*` 属性上(CSS 闸门,改属性立刻改变行为),
同时存进一枚 cookie,让宿主半在首帧渲染前就把状态恢复好(否则会先按官方配色画一帧再跳)。

唯一需要重启的情况是**插件本体更新**:客户端半随页面刷新/热重载换新,宿主半(几个 `/enh/*` 接口、
首帧注入脚本)由 dsh 进程在启动时加载,换不了。设置页顶部会比对两半的构建号,一旦对不上就直接写明
「重启 DeepSeek Harness 后生效」,并提供「重新检测」。这也是 `GET /enh/ping` 的用途。

## 安装

前置:已按 DSH 的 profile 机制运行(`dsh web`)。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiangnanquan/dsh-ux#main
```

本包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`,`dsh plugin add` 会自动把它加入 profile 的 bundles,
**重启 dsh 后即生效**,无需手改任何配置。重复执行该命令是安全的(幂等);升级用
`dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-enhance`。

> **官方桌面版不使用这条命令**:`desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占,
> `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被直接拒绝。桌面版装法见
> [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)。

## 交给你的 AI

不想手动敲命令?把下面这段话粘贴给任意 AI agent(Claude Code、dsh、Gemini CLI……),让它读 INSTALL.md 并完成安装与自检:

> 请按照 https://github.com/jiangnanquan/dsh-ux/blob/main/INSTALL.md 里的步骤,在我的机器上安装并验证 dsh-enhance 插件(profile 用 web),然后运行文档里的健康检查并告诉我结果。如果任何一步失败,按文档的回滚步骤恢复原状并说明原因。

## 依赖与前提

- **字体**:推荐安装**更纱黑体**(Sarasa Gothic 的 `Sarasa-SuperTTC`,或 `Sarasa Term/Mono SC` 单独字重)——
  它是唯一同时满足「西文 0.5 窄体 + 汉字 1.0 正方」且中西文字重曲线对齐过的免费字族。
  没有更纱时可用 [Noto Sans Mono CJK SC](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk)(同为 0.5/1.0,但只有 Regular/Bold),
  或继续用 [Maple Mono](https://github.com/subframe7536/maple-font)(西文 0.6、汉字 1.2)。
  一款都没装时字体层自动落回官方字体栈,不影响其余功能。
- **余额 / 本轮成本 / 用量图表 / 峰谷提醒**:调用 DeepSeek 官方接口,需要当前 DSH 已配置
  `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 凭据;未配置时这些信息显示为查询失败/不可用,不影响其余功能。
- 计价表按官方峰谷价(北京时间 9–12、14–18 高峰,其余空闲半价)硬编码,官方调价后需更新
  `lib/index.js` 里的 `pricingFor`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-enhance
```

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # rdsh-agent-ui エージェントが会話の途中で提示したUIを**DSHのWebチャット内**に表示し、人間の選択を **同じセッションへ返す**プラグインです。見本の展示ではなく、往復を目的としています。 ## 動き 1. エージェントが surface を公開する（`DSH_HOME/agent-ui/surface.json`、または認証付き POST） 2. チャットの各ターン末尾にパネルが表示され、グラフ・表・選択肢・差分・テスト結果を描画する 3. 人間が選択すると、選択内容が**通常のユーザーメッセージ**として同じセッションへ送信される 4. 選択内容は `DSH_HOME/agent-ui/actions.jsonl` にも記録される（送信に失敗した場合の控え） ## 出る場所 パネルは**会話の流れの中**に表示されます。エージェントがメッセージに記述した目印（anchor_text）の ターンへ固定され、目印がない場合は最初に表示されたターンで一度だけ固定されます（sessionStorage）。 新しい surface を最初に表示したターンの末尾がその surface を 引き取り、その位置に固定されます（`surface.turn`）。会話が進んでも末尾へ移動せず、 履歴と一緒にスクロールします。次の版を出せば、その時点のターンが新しく引き取ります。 送信後は「送信済み」と表示され、**選び直す**で同じ surface に対しもう一度答えられます。 surface を削除すればパネルも消えます。 ## ファイル - `store.js`：surface の検証と保存、操作の追記（重複は request_id で排除） - `index.js`：認証付きHTTPルート（`/api/rdsh-agent-ui/surface`、`/api/rdsh-agent-ui/action`） - `client.js`：チャットのターン末尾に表示するパネル（React、DSHのテーマ変数を使用） - `test/store.test.mjs`：検証・保存・追記の単体テスト ## 安全側の約束 - 値はテキストまたはSVG要素としてのみ描画し、**エージェント由来のHTML/JSは実行しない** - 未知の種別や破損したデータは描画せず、理由を表示する - 数値が未取得のときは `null` を使い、**0で埋めない** - ルートはDSHのGUIセッションとHost/Origin検証を通過した要求だけを受け付ける - ボタンは選択・入力の返送のみを行い、実行権限は発行しない（要求型は記録のみ） ## 使い方（配布先プロファイルへ） ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/rustdsh/plugins/rdsh-agent-ui ``` ## 検証 ```sh node --test plugins/rdsh-agent-ui/test/store.test.mjs ``` # rdsh — a fast, safe Rust launcher for `dsh` [![ci](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![dashboard](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/dashboard.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/dashboard.yml) [![docs](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/docs.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/actions/workflows/docs.yml) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.svg)](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases) [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/rdsh.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/rdsh) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.85%2B-orange.svg)](https://www.rust-lang.org/) [日本語](README.ja.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) An independent community project; not an official DeepSeek or DeepSeek Harness project. `rdsh` is a fast, safe launcher for [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It ports frequently used CLI operations (token calculation, code search, session management) to native Rust, while delegating conversation workflows and model execution transparently to upstream `dsh`. All existing arguments and options continue to work as-is. ## Why rdsh? - ⚡ **Sub-millisecond process launch**: `rdsh --version` starts in ~0.90 ms with ~2.9 MB peak RSS, versus ~88 ms and ~66 MB for Node.js-based `dsh --version`. This is process launch only: a booted agent profile still runs upstream Node.js, so conversation startup and session memory match upstream. See [Benchmarks](#benchmarks). - 🔄 **100% Drop-in Compatible**: Subcommands that are not rdsh-native are passed straight to upstream `dsh`. Existing scripts and workflows keep running unchanged. - 🛠 **Fast Native Utilities**: Estimate tokens, search code, list sessions, and run health diagnostics (`rdsh doctor`) instantly without starting Node.js. - 🛡 **Safe by Default**: Read-only commands never modify source files, credentials are never automatically synced or exported, and `rdsh_inspect` can be confined to explicitly shared files on Linux. - 🛠 **Fast Native Utilities**: Estimate tokens, search code, list sessions, and inspect local prerequisites (`rdsh doctor --json`) without starting Node.js. - 🛡 **Safe by Default**: Read-only commands never modify source files, credentials are never automatically synced or exported, and agent tools can be confined to explicitly shared files on Linux. ## Table of Contents - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Running with `dsh` Compatibility](#running-with-dsh-compatibility) - [Fast Native Commands](#fast-native-commands) - [Credential sharing with rdsh auth](#credential-sharing-with-rdsh-auth) - [Agent Tool Isolation](#agent-tool-isolation) - [Hook Guard](#hook-guard-rdsh-guard) - [Context Injection](#context-injection-rdsh-context) - [Dependency Graph and Change Impact](#dependency-graph-and-change-impact-rdsh-deps) - [Web UI & Dashboard](#web-ui--dashboard) - [Using with Smart-DSH](#using-with-smart-dsh) - [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) - [Safety Design](#safety-design) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Community](#community) - [Credits](#credits) - [License](#license) ## Quick Start Already using **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, OpenCode or Gemini CLI**? [Connect the project dashboard through MCP](docs/MCP-CLIENTS.md) to share tasks, questions and structured UI while keeping your current coding agent. This entry point requires Node.js 22+; DSH and Rust are optional. ### 1. Install (Prebuilt Binary) **Linux / macOS / WSL**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash -s -- --from-release ``` **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'rdsh-install.ps1' Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 -OutFile $f -UseBasicParsing & $f -FromRelease ``` Or install the crate from crates.io (needs Rust 1.85+): ```sh cargo install rdsh ``` `cargo install` builds from source and installs the same binary as the release archives. Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora/RHEL users can also install the release [`.deb`/`.rpm`](#native-packages-deb--rpm) with `apt`/`dnf`. ### 2. Verify & Setup ```sh rdsh --version && rdsh doctor # verify install and original dsh rdsh setup # interactive setup (or rdsh setup --web for browser UI) ``` *Note: If you have an existing login from Codex CLI (ChatGPT OAuth) or opencode, import it with `rdsh auth --import --provider openai-codex`.* ### 3. Start a Conversation ```sh rdsh tui # start with TUI profile # or rdsh --profile web # start with Web profile ``` ## Requirements | Item | Detail | | --- | --- | | OS | Linux, macOS, WSL, Windows (native) | | DSH runtime | Required for conversations and agent runs (native tools and diagnostics run standalone) | | Rust | 1.85+ (only needed when building from source; prebuilt binaries require no Rust) | | Optional | Node.js 22+ for the [Node.js dashboard](dashboard/README.md); SearXNG for `search-web` | ## Installation ### Native Packages (`.deb` / `.rpm`) Linux x86_64 users on Debian/Ubuntu (and WSL) or Fedora/RHEL can install the same release binary with the OS package manager. Download the `.deb` or `.rpm` from the [latest release](https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/releases/latest) and install that file directly; no extra repository is configured. ```sh sudo apt install ./rdsh__amd64.deb # Debian, Ubuntu, WSL sudo dnf install ./rdsh--1.x86_64.rpm # Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, AlmaLinux ``` `` is the release tag without its leading `v` (`0.6.0` for `v0.6.0`). The package installs `/usr/bin/rdsh` together with the licence and README, so `rdsh --version` works right after installation: no Rust toolchain, no `install.sh`. Like `rdsh-linux-x64.tar.gz`, both packages carry the glibc build, so the musl archive and `install.sh` stay the fallback for older distributions. ### Building from Source & Advanced Options **Linux / macOS / WSL**: ```sh git clone https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.git cd rustdsh ./install.sh # build + install to ~/.local/bin/rdsh ./install.sh --as-dsh # also replace `dsh` command (original backed up as dsh-orig) ./install.sh --restore # undo the replacement ./install.sh --prefix=DIR # custom install directory (default: ~/.local/bin) ``` **Windows (PowerShell)**: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh.git cd rustdsh .\install.ps1 # build + install to %LOCALAPPDATA%\rdsh\bin .\install.ps1 -AsDsh # also replace `dsh` command .\install.ps1 -Restore # undo the replacement .\install.ps1 -Wsl # also install inside WSL via install.sh ``` | OS | Script | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Linux / macOS | `./install.sh` | Needs `cargo` or `curl` (guided via rustup if missing). | | WSL | `./install.sh` inside distro | Auto-detects WSL. `install.ps1 -Wsl` installs in both environments. | | Windows (native) | `.\install.ps1` | Needs Rust and MSVC build tools (`winget install Rustlang.Rustup`). | ### Package Managers (Homebrew / Scoop / winget) Advanced users on macOS and Windows can let a package manager own the installed `rdsh` binary. The manifests in [packaging/](packaging/README.md) pin the exact release archives and their SHA-256 values; [docs/PACKAGE-MANAGERS.md](docs/PACKAGE-MANAGERS.md) lists the install commands and the update procedure. **macOS (Homebrew)** — installs the Apple Silicon or Intel archive: ```sh brew install --formula ./packaging/homebrew/rdsh.rb ``` **Windows (Scoop)**: ```powershell scoop install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jimoto-no-llm/rustdsh/main/packaging/scoop/rdsh.json ``` **Windows (winget)** — winget 1.6 or newer reads the three manifests directly; submitting them to `microsoft/winget-pkgs` stays a manual step: ```powershell winget install --manifest .\packaging\winget ``` These channels track one release at a time, so a new tag is not served until `python3 scripts/update-packaging-manifests.py --version vX.Y.Z` refreshes them. ## Usage ### Running with `dsh` Compatibility Run any standard `dsh` command unchanged: ```sh rdsh tui # equivalent to: dsh --profile tui rdsh --profile web --patch x.yml # launch with configuration overlay rdsh --dry-run tui -- --resume id # print what would be executed ``` When installed with `./install.sh --as-dsh`, typing `dsh` automatically uses the fast `rdsh` launcher. ### Fast Native Commands Native tools execute in Rust without starting Node.js: ```sh rdsh tokens ./README.md # estimate token count (~4 chars = 1 tok, CJK = 1 tok each) echo "..." | rdsh prune --max-tokens 4000 # prune context within a token budget rdsh search TODO --dir . --max 100 # fast parallel text search rdsh sessions --limit 20 --tokens # list sessions and unpacked token estimates rdsh compact ./s.jsonl # compact session JSONL (source remains untouched) rdsh doctor # check health of dsh, environment, and paths rdsh doctor --json # read-only metadata for scripts; no DSH/Node launch rdsh profiles / rdsh skills # list available profiles and skills rdsh desktop status # detect the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and profile rdsh bench --n 5 # benchmark startup speed between rdsh and dsh ``` On Windows, compressed session histories are not opened until rdsh can reject parent junctions safely; `sessions --tokens` may omit those histories and its totals are inexact. ### Credential sharing with rdsh auth External credentials are inventoried without showing their values. Nothing is copied until you select a source and credential. OAuth copies use DSH's existing version-1 store at $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml; API keys use its named refs. The selection policy contains only identifiers at $DSH_HOME/rdsh-auth-sharing.json. ```sh rdsh auth # sources, destinations, selection and undo steps rdsh auth --json # secret-free machine-readable inventory rdsh --dry-run auth --select codex:openai-codex --import # preview; writes no files rdsh auth --select codex:openai-codex --import # share only Codex OAuth rdsh auth --select opencode:openai-codex --import # OpenCode openai maps to openai-codex rdsh auth --select codex:OPENAI_API_KEY --import # separate opt-in for Codex's API key rdsh auth --select env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY --import # explicitly persist this environment key rdsh auth --unselect codex:openai-codex # stop future copies; retain the existing copy rdsh setup # sync selected credentials, then guide setup rdsh setup --web # inventory, selection commands and explicit key save ``` For a one-time import, use `rdsh auth --import --provider openai-codex --source codex` or `rdsh auth --import --ref OPENAI_API_KEY --source codex`. These filters do not save or extend future-copy consent; `--select`/`--unselect` are separate persistent policy changes. Repeat --select/--unselect for individual credentials. Selecting enables future imports from that CLI/provider, including boot, dump-config, plugin, raw dsh delegation and setup. --import immediately applies the selection. Even a newer grant in another, unselected CLI cannot be chosen. Newer DSH grants and existing API-key refs/records remain in place. Other entries, comments and line endings are preserved. Unix credential and policy files use mode 0600. The inventory checks Codex's ~/.codex/auth.json and OpenCode's $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/auth.json (or its platform default data directory), plus the legacy ~/.config/opencode/auth.json fallback. Selectors for OpenCode use DSH provider IDs; opencode:openai-codex is the selector for its openai login. Environment-key persistence supports DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. These are format/presence checks, not live authentication tests. An environment variable already supplied to rdsh is inherited by DSH and its child processes without rdsh writing a file. The JSON inventory marks this route persistent=false, lists its destination and explains how to stop/revoke it. Using the reference does not opt in to storing it. setup --yes no longer saves every environment key; choose each one with auth --select env:NAME --import. Interactive setup and the web form still allow an explicit, individual key save. **Scope and undo:** saved entries are available to every DSH profile using the same DSH_HOME. Unselect stops future rdsh imports; it does not delete a saved copy or invalidate a running process. Stop DSH and remove the named record/ref from the credential store to stop using a saved copy. To invalidate the credential itself, revoke the OAuth grant or rotate the API key at its provider. That may also disconnect the source CLI. This controls rdsh copying, not DSH's own refreshes, inherited environment access or an OS sandbox. **Migration:** existing DSH credentials are retained. A missing policy selects nothing, including for legacy auth --import. RDSH_AUTH_AUTOSYNC=1 does not restore the old import-all behavior. Inventory and preview first, then choose the sources you need. RDSH_AUTH_AUTOSYNC=0 disables automatic imports while keeping the selection; an explicit auth --import still works. Invalid/unreadable policies fail closed instead of falling back to legacy sync. Consent changes and rdsh credential writes share a lock, so a completed unselect cannot be bypassed by a queued rdsh import using an earlier policy. After a crashed writer, check that no rdsh auth/setup writer is active before removing $DSH_HOME/.rdsh-auth-sharing.lock; the launcher skips copying while it is locked. setup --web issues a new local access key at startup in its #key=... URL. The tab retains that key; status reads, key saves and closing require it. Keep the startup URL private. The page shows copy destinations and separate unselect, saved-copy removal and provider revocation steps before a key save. ### Optional extras (off by default) Server-type features and the privacy-sensitive switches (`discord`, `telemetry`) stay off until enabled, so a plain install remains a fast, telemetry-free dsh: ```sh rdsh settings set extras.enable serve,search-web rdsh settings get extras.enable ``` | Extra | Command | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `serve` | `rdsh serve` (default :38080) | Local status page, localhost only, per-launch key. | | `search-web` | `rdsh search-web "query" --limit 5` | Needs SearXNG. | To connect an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that dsh does not ship (HAI, Sarashina, a home llama.cpp / vLLM / LM Studio / Ollama server), add it as a profile route: ```sh rdsh provider add hai --model deepseek-v4-flash # key from HAI_API_KEY or --key-stdin rdsh provider add sarashina # key from SARASHINA_API_KEY; mini and nano built in rdsh provider add local-openai --base-url http://host:8080/v1 --discover --no-key rdsh provider list # presets, per-profile route and key status ``` Details: [docs/PROVIDERS.md](docs/PROVIDERS.md). ### Model Catalog (`rdsh models`) DeepSeek Harness answers "which models can this provider serve?" from the catalog bundled in its `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency, which is generated when that package is published. Anything a provider changes afterwards is absent from the picker until that dependency is upgraded — and a profile that lists `models:` explicitly replaces the bundled catalog for the route anyway. `rdsh models` reads the provider's own catalog (the local Codex CLI, or Kimi Code's `/v1/models` endpoint with the profile's API key) and folds it into the profile: ```sh rdsh models # read-only: missing ids and stale names rdsh models --provider kimi-coding # one provider only rdsh models sync # add missing entries, refresh stale names rdsh models sync --profile web --dry-run # preview one profile ``` Nothing is deleted, an existing entry keeps every other byte (a name the provider's current one already contains is left as written), and a profile the command does not recognize is refused instead of rewritten. The harness picks the changes up on the next config reload or restart. ### Agent Tool Isolation Delegated agent tools keep normal file access by default: the model reads and writes the project like any other tool. `--share-file` isolates **`rdsh_inspect` only**. On Linux (with bubblewrap and prlimit) that tool sees just the files you explicitly share: ```sh rdsh --share-file README.md --share-file src/main.rs --profile tui ``` From `rdsh_inspect`, only the shared files are mounted read-only, host files stay out of reach and the sandbox has no network. Turn the same boundary on for every run with `rdsh features on agent_tool_sandbox` (off again with `rdsh features off agent_tool_sandbox`, or force it with `RDSH_SECURITY=1`). Other DSH tools (`bash`, `read`, `write`, `run_code`, ...) are **not** isolated and follow upstream DSH permissions and approvals. Startup prints `[rdsh security] rdsh_inspect is isolated; other DSH tools use upstream permissions`. ### Hook Guard (`rdsh guard`) Integrates with DSH `hooks.json` to inspect and block dangerous commands before execution: ```sh echo "$input" | rdsh guard --deny "rm -rf /*" --deny "*token*" ``` For an opt-in structured check of supported file tools, pass a policy file. This example permits `Read` only under one existing project directory: ```json { "schema": 1, "rules": [ { "id": "project-read", "tool": "Read", "access": "read", "roots": ["/absolute/project/path"] } ] } ``` ```sh echo "$hook_json" | rdsh guard --policy-file ./hook-policy.json --json ``` The structured classifier supports the `Read`, `Write`, and `Edit` file-path schemas. It canonicalizes the working directory and target, checks the selected tool and read/write scope against existing policy roots, and reports `allow`, `deny`, or `unknown` with a non-sensitive reason. In JSON mode an `allow` is classification only and omits `decision`; the host still owns permission and approval. Unknown tools, shell commands, malformed input, and unsupported tool arguments fail closed. Shell parsing and network destinations are not implemented. Path checks are advisory and can race with later filesystem changes; this hook is not an OS sandbox. Use the actual execution sandbox for enforcement. ```json { "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [ { "matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "rdsh guard --deny \"rm -rf /*\"" }] } ] } } ``` ### Context Injection (`rdsh context`) `rdsh context inject` assembles this turn's context — goal, constraints, decisions, working set, git state, retrieved code, and curated memory — and emits it in the DSH `UserPromptSubmit` hook contract, so the model sees it without any copy-paste: ```sh rdsh features on context_engine # the engine is opt-in rdsh context hook install # merges $DSH_HOME/hooks.json (idempotent) rdsh context hook status --json ``` The hook is fail-open: it never blocks a prompt and always exits 0. Only an unreadable settings document or an unparseable payload inject nothing at all; a corrupt index or a missed deadline drops just what depends on them — the graph or the code search — and still injects goal, constraints, and memory. Injection has its own budget (`context.inject_budget`, default 1200 tokens) and deadline (`context.inject_deadline_ms`, default 1200 ms); once the deadline passes the code search is skipped and only memory, goal, and constraints go out. Memory holds curated items, not a transcript dump: ```sh rdsh context remember "Keep the API compatible" --kind constraint rdsh context distill --session ~/.dsh/sessions///session.v4.jsonl.zstd --apply rdsh context memory --json # active and superseded entries rdsh context forget mem_ab12cd34ef56 ``` `distill` reads user turns only (zstd session logs included) and extracts decisions, constraints, and retractions with deterministic markers, superseding an older overlapping entry instead of guessing. `rdsh context build --require-stable` exits 3 unless the snapshot is provably stable: a file or git state that changed during assembly counts, and so does a git state it cannot read, so a stale or unknown snapshot is never reported as fresh. ### Dependency Graph and Change Impact (`rdsh deps`) ```sh rdsh deps build # incremental index under $DSH_HOME/rdsh-index rdsh deps query engine_score # where a symbol is defined and referenced rdsh deps impact src/context.rs # direct/transitive dependents + affected tests ``` The extractor covers Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Go and records imports, definitions, and static call sites per file. Unchanged files (same size and mtime) are reused, so repeated runs stay fast. It is a static approximation: dynamic dispatch, indirect calls, macros, and generated code remain explicitly `unknown` and are reported as unresolved counts rather than guessed, and a missing index means "no information", never "no dependencies". When the index exists, `rdsh context build` and `rdsh context inject` also pull in the graph neighbours of the files their search matched, so a retrieved excerpt arrives with the files it actually depends on. Native execution overhead is ~1 ms per invocation. ## Low-end hosts Default profile: `RDSH_DEFAULT_PROFILE`, then `general.default_profile` in rdsh settings, then local `tui`, else a guided error. Set the saved default with `rdsh settings set general.default_profile web`; an explicit `--profile ` keeps its precedence. rdsh aims to remain useful on modest machines: older x86-64 CPUs, older Linux distributions, and hosts without Node.js installed. - **Faster Node startup.** When rdsh launches dsh, it sets `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` to `~/.cache/rdsh-node-compile-cache`, letting Node reuse compiled code across launches (Node 22.1 or newer; older versions ignore it). An existing `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` value is preserved. Set `RDSH_NODE_COMPILE_CACHE=0`, or use `--passthrough` / `RDSH_PASSTHROUGH=1`, to opt out. - **Broad CPU support.** Prebuilt x86-64 binaries do not require AVX or BMI; the static musl build also runs on systems with older glibc. - **Session token estimates.** `sessions --tokens` reads a decompressed size from the zstd frame header when available. Most streaming frames need the `zstd -dc` fallback. Results are cached under `~/.cache/rdsh/sessions-tokens.json` (`$XDG_CACHE_HOME` takes precedence); set `RDSH_TOKENS_CACHE=0` to disable the cache. A `?` marks an estimate that could not be read, for example when the zstd CLI is unavailable. - **Bounded parallel work.** Search and session scans use at most eight worker threads. The zstd CLI fallback uses 8 to 32 parallel processes. - **Native commands without Node.** Commands such as `tokens`, `search`, and `sessions` keep working without Node. To delegate conversations, install `@deepseek-ai/dsh` or set `DSH_ORIG_BIN` (or `RDSH_ORIG_BIN`). - **Low-priority updates.** `sync-dsh.sh` updates dsh and rdsh, verifies archive bytes against that registry, and rolls back a failed update candidate. By default it uses the stable release selected by the reviewed repository digest registry; set `RDSH_SYNC_FROM_SOURCE=1` to build from `main` under `nice -n 19` and `ionice -c3` when available. The systemd unit runs at low priority; adjust its `ExecStart` to your checkout. ## Web UI & Dashboard ### Lightweight Local Web UI (`rdsh serve`) A lightweight status and token estimation page running on localhost (default `:38080`, does not conflict with DSH `:3080`): ```sh rdsh settings set extras.enable serve # enable the server feature rdsh serve # launch (bound to localhost, protected with a one-time token) ``` ### Product language rdsh-owned CLI diagnostics and the native local page support English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese. Choose one run with `--language`, or persist it in `rdsh.json`; the default `auto` reads the first nonblank locale environment variable, falling back to English when it is absent or unsupported. ```sh rdsh --language ja settings show rdsh settings set general.language zh-CN ``` Precedence is `--language`, `RDSH_LANG`, `general.language`, then `LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, and `LANG`. An explicitly invalid `general.language` stops the command without rewriting the settings file. Delegated `dsh` arguments, model output, JSON fields, files, and protocol identifiers are not translated. Interactive setup prompts and settings/policy validation use the selected language too. Authentication decisions and skipped-provider notes localize only the CLI presentation; their existing JSON strings remain unchanged, including malformed or oversized guard-input reasons. Native search continues to refuse unsupported non-Unix platforms before accessing the requested directory. `worker-scope validate` and `worker-scope policy` also localize their help and CLI diagnostics. These pure commands and their help ignore unrelated corrupt settings; ordinary commands and root help still report the settings error. Canonical JSON, policy codes and supplied paths stay unchanged. ### Protected delegated tools The opt-in agent tool sandbox supports Linux x86_64 with bubblewrap, prlimit, and unprivileged user namespaces. Its audited DSH/tool-runtime pairs are `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.1`, and `0.2.1-alpha.3`, with matching versions in each pair. It verifies package metadata, runtime bytes and the loaded module, then limits inspection to explicitly shared files. Unknown, mixed, modified or unexpectedly resolved runtimes stop before delegation. macOS and Windows refuse protected delegation; ordinary delegation keeps the original tools. This matrix applies to the Rust launcher. Project-pinned dashboard releases retain their separate [supported tuple](docs/STAGED-UPDATES.md#capture-trusted-runtime-code). ### Extended Dashboard (`rdsh-dashboard`) Optional Node.js dashboard for project metrics, human-in-the-loop Q&A, and mobile access (requires Node.js 22+): ```sh rdsh-dashboard project --project ``` *On native Windows, the dashboard runs in the system tray and can be opened or stopped from the taskbar (`--no-tray` keeps it in the terminal). See [dashboard/README.md](dashboard/README.md). External agent CLIs (cursor-agent, devin) can be run as supervised jobs: see [docs/AGENT-RUNNERS.md](docs/AGENT-RUNNERS.md).* ## Desktop App (Electron) DeepSeek Harness Desktop is an Electron shell around the complete Web application. It shares `$DSH_HOME` with the CLI but owns a **reserved profile** (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop`) and its own bundled command runtime, so the npm `dsh` CLI cannot manage its plugins. `rdsh desktop` detects all of that and forwards plugin attachment to the app's own command — rdsh never boots or rewrites the profile: ```sh rdsh desktop status # app, command runtime, profile, plugin state (read-only) rdsh desktop install --plugins-dir . # rdsh-settings + default third-party (sound, gitview) rdsh desktop install --plugins-dir . --compute # + the resident compute bridge rdsh desktop install --plugins-dir . --no-sound --no-gitview # skip third-party rdsh desktop verify # exit nonzero when the profile has no rdsh plugin ``` The same is available through the profile installer and the installers: ```sh PROFILE=desktop ./plugins/install.sh # essential + default recommended, forwarded correctly ./install.sh --desktop # attach the rdsh plugins during installation ``` *Quit the app before attaching plugins, reopen it afterwards. The app's own Plugins page installs the same packages without any command. The Electron runtime itself is never replaced: in-app delega
